subject: english
q: The clock shows the exact time, so it is ____.
explain: accurate 指「準確的」，符合時間完全正確的線索；actual 是「實際的」，current 是「目前的」。

subject: english
q: Every room is booked tonight, so none is ____ for anyone else to book.
explain: available 意為「可供使用的」；所有房間都已訂滿，因此沒有空房，occupied 則是「已被占用的」。

subject: english
q: Water is ____ for survival; people cannot live without it.
explain: essential 意為「不可或缺的」；不能沒有水的線索，排除表示「非必要的」optional。

subject: english
q: Nothing unusual happened; it was just an ____ day.
explain: ordinary 意為「平凡的」；nothing unusual 表示沒有不尋常的事，exceptional 則是「非凡的」。

subject: english
q: Mia is ____; she gladly shares her food and money with others.
explain: generous 意為「慷慨的」，願意分享食物與金錢；selfish 是「自私的」，greedy 是「貪心的」。

subject: english
q: This is a ____ office; we will leave it when repairs to our building are finished.
explain: temporary 意為「暫時的」；大樓修好就會搬離，並非 permanent「永久的」辦公室。

subject: english
q: Although she knew the answer, fear of being wrong made her ____ before speaking.
explain: hesitate 意為「猶豫」；雖知道答案，卻因怕答錯而遲疑，insist 則是「堅持」。

subject: english
q: The museum controls light and temperature to ____ its ancient paintings from damage.
explain: preserve 意為「保存、保護」；控制光線與溫度是為了防止古畫受損，replace 是「取代」。

subject: english
q: The twins look so alike that I cannot ____ one from the other.
explain: distinguish 意為「區分、辨別」；雙胞胎太像而難以分辨，distract 是「使分心」。

subject: english
q: After a week of rest, Leo began to ____ from the flu and felt much better.
explain: recover from 意為「從……康復」；休息後病況好轉，suffer from 則是「受……所苦」。

subject: english
q: This machine does the same work with less energy, making it more ____.
explain: efficient 意為「有效率的」；完成同樣工作卻耗能較少，是效率提升，不一定代表更 powerful「強大的」。

subject: english
q: My skin is ____ to this soap; it becomes red and sore.
explain: sensitive 意為「敏感的」，皮膚接觸肥皂後發紅疼痛符合語境；sensible 則是「明智的」。

subject: english
q: Eva was ____ to lend her car, so she agreed only after repeated requests.
explain: reluctant 意為「不情願的」；多次請求後才同意，不能選 eager「渴望的」或 willing「樂意的」。

subject: english
q: An ____ delay is one that cannot be prevented, no matter what we do.
explain: inevitable 意為「不可避免的」；即使努力也無法防止，與 accidental「偶然的」意思不同。

subject: english
q: To remain ____, the judge relied on evidence rather than personal feelings.
explain: objective 在此是「客觀的」，強調依證據判斷；emotional 是「情緒化的」，sympathetic 是「同情的」。

subject: english
q: His account stayed ____; every retelling contained the same details.
explain: consistent 意為「一致的」；每次重述細節都相同，variable 則是「會變動的」。

subject: english
q: The repairs cost a ____ amount, so the final bill was extremely high.
explain: considerable 意為「相當大的」；帳單金額極高，不能選表示「少量的」modest 或「微不足道的」trivial。

subject: english
q: The treatment has ____ benefits, but further tests must show whether it actually helps.
explain: potential 意為「潛在的、可能的」；療效仍待測試，不能說是 proven「已證實的」或 guaranteed「有保證的」。

subject: english
q: Without exact figures, we can only ____ how much the repairs will cost.
explain: estimate 意為「估計」；缺少確切數據只能估算，confirm 是「確認」，guarantee 是「保證」。

subject: english
q: The teacher repeated the warning to ____ the importance of online safety.
explain: emphasize 意為「強調」；重複警告是為了凸顯網路安全的重要性，conceal 是「隱瞞」。

subject: english
q: A ____ is a result of an action; for example, missing class may lead to falling behind.
explain: consequence 意為「結果、後果」；缺課導致進度落後是因果關係，coincidence 則是「巧合」。

subject: english
q: We cannot use Plan A, so we need an ____, such as Plan B.
explain: alternative 作名詞指「替代方案」；原計畫不可行，便需要另一個方案，exception 是「例外」。

subject: english
q: When water is scarce, there is plenty of it.
explain: scarce 意為「缺乏的、稀少的」；plenty of 是「大量的」，兩者意思相反。

subject: english
q: A precise measurement is exact rather than rough.
explain: precise 意為「精確的」；exact 是「確切的」，rough 在此是「粗略的」。

subject: english
q: To assume something is to accept it as true without being certain.
explain: assume 意為「假定、認為」，表示尚未確定就暫時當作真實，並不等於證實。

subject: english
q: In 'We eventually arrived after several delays,' eventually means immediately.
explain: eventually 意為「最後、終於」；多次延誤後才抵達，不是 immediately「立刻」。

subject: english
q: In 'Please reserve a table for six,' reserve means book in advance.
explain: reserve 在此意為「預訂」；book in advance 就是「事先預訂」，不是現場挑選。

subject: english
q: In 'She politely declined the invitation,' declined means accepted.
explain: decline 在邀請的語境中意為「婉拒」，與 accept「接受」相反。

subject: english
q: In 'The project produced a modest profit,' modest means enormous.
explain: modest 在修飾金額時指「不大的、有限的」，不是 enormous「龐大的」，也不是指人的謙虛。

subject: english
q: In 'The business plans to expand abroad,' expand means become larger.
explain: expand 意為「擴展、擴大」；expand abroad 指拓展海外業務，abroad 是「在國外、到國外」。

subject: english
q: The puzzle was difficult, but Sue refused to ____ and kept trying.
explain: give up 意為「放棄」；kept trying 表示持續嘗試，give away 是「贈送、洩漏」。

subject: english
q: We have ____ milk, so there is none left for breakfast.
explain: run out of 意為「用完」；none left 表示一點也沒剩，run into 是「偶然遇見」。

subject: english
q: Could you ____ my cat by feeding her while I am away?
explain: look after 意為「照顧」；需要替貓餵食，look for 是「尋找」，look into 是「調查」。

subject: english
q: Everyone can take part ____ the school festival; no experience is required.
explain: take part in 是「參加」活動的固定搭配，介系詞用 in。

subject: english
q: Her parents are proud ____ her honesty, even though she lost the game.
explain: be proud of 意為「以……為榮」；honesty 是「誠實」，此處為父母感到驕傲的原因。

subject: english
q: The outdoor concert was ____ until next Friday because of the storm.
explain: put off 意為「延期」；until next Friday 提供時間線索，put out 是「撲滅」，put on 是「穿上、上演」。

subject: english
q: I look forward to ____ from you soon.
explain: look forward to 意為「期待」，to 是介系詞，後接動名詞 hearing；hearing from you 是「收到你的消息」。

subject: english
q: The fence prevents children ____ entering the construction site.
explain: prevent A from V-ing 意為「阻止 A 做某事」；construction site 是「工地」。

subject: english
q: With his injured ankle, Tom could not ____ the faster runners.
explain: keep up with 意為「跟上」；腳踝受傷使他跟不上，catch up on 是「補做、補上」。

subject: english
q: Each team member is responsible ____ checking one part of the report.
explain: be responsible for 意為「負責……」；後接 checking「檢查」，說明負責的工作。

subject: english
q: You need to ____ an effort if you want to improve your pronunciation.
explain: make an effort 意為「努力」，動詞固定搭配 make；pronunciation 是「發音」。

subject: english
q: When choosing a phone, take battery life into ____, not just the price.
explain: take ... into account 意為「把……納入考量」；battery life 是「電池續航力」。

subject: english
q: After hours of discussion, the team finally ____ a workable solution.
explain: come up with 意為「想出」；討論後提出可行解決辦法，come down with 是「罹患」。

subject: english
q: The noise is unbearable; I cannot ____ it any longer.
explain: put up with 意為「忍受」；unbearable 是「難以忍受的」，get along with 多指「與……相處」。

subject: english
q: The film was disappointing; it failed to live up ____ my expectations.
explain: live up to expectations 意為「符合期望」；disappointing 表示「令人失望的」，所以未達期望。

subject: english
q: If a car breaks down, it stops working.
explain: break down 用於車輛或機器時意為「故障」，也就是停止正常運作。

subject: english
q: To take after a parent means to look after that parent.
explain: take after 意為「外貌或個性像」某位家人；look after 才是「照顧」。

subject: english
q: 'In spite of the rain' and 'despite the rain' express the same contrast.
explain: in spite of 與 despite 都表示「儘管」；兩者後方可直接接名詞，despite 後不加 of。

subject: english
q: In 'Look up the word in a dictionary,' look up means search for information.
explain: look up 在字典情境中指「查閱」；search for information 是「查找資訊」。

subject: english
q: In 'He turned down the offer,' turned down means lowered the volume.
explain: turn down 在此指「拒絕」提議；受詞是音量或設備時，才可表示「調小音量」。

subject: english
q: Listen! Someone ____ at the door right now.
explain: right now 是「現在」，配合 Listen! 可知敲門正在發生，用現在進行式 is knocking。

subject: english
q: I ____ my grandparents yesterday afternoon.
explain: yesterday afternoon 是「昨天下午」，明確指出過去時間，動詞用過去式 visited「探望了」。

subject: english
q: Nora ____ in Taipei since 2020 and still lives there.
explain: since 2020 是「自二〇二〇年以來」，且現在仍居住在臺北，用現在完成式 has lived。

subject: english
q: I missed the train because it ____ before I reached the station.
explain: 火車在「我抵達」這個過去動作之前就已離開，用過去完成式 had left「已經離開」。

subject: english
q: I will call you as soon as I ____ home tomorrow.
explain: as soon as 意為「一……就……」；表示未來的時間副詞子句用現在式 get，不用 will get。

subject: english
q: The girl ____ won the race is my sister.
explain: 先行詞 girl 是「女孩」，關係代名詞在子句中作主詞，用 who；whose 表示「誰的」。

subject: english
q: I know a student ____ father teaches at our school.
explain: whose 意為「其……的」，修飾 father「父親」，whose father 就是「那位學生的父親」。

subject: english
q: The bus, ____ was already full, drove past us.
explain: bus 是「公車」，非限定關係子句補充說明事物時用 which，不能用 that。

subject: english
q: ____ by the sudden noise, the baby began to cry.
explain: 嬰兒是「受到驚嚇」的一方，用過去分詞 Frightened；frightening 意為「令人害怕的」。

subject: english
q: ____ all her money, Nina could not afford a bus ticket.
explain: 花光錢發生在買不起車票之前，且 Nina 是主動花錢，用 Having spent「已花光」引導分詞構句。

subject: english
q: If I ____ you, I would apologize to her.
explain: 與現在事實相反的假設，用 If I were you「如果我是你」；apologize 是「道歉」。

subject: english
q: If Ben had set an alarm, he ____ the early train yesterday.
explain: had set an alarm 是「當時有設鬧鐘」的過去反事實假設，主句用 would have caught「本來會趕上」。

subject: english
q: I wish I ____ more time now, but the deadline is in an hour.
explain: wish 後表達與現在事實相反的願望，用過去式 had「有」；now 排除表示過去遺憾的 had had。

subject: english
q: Never ____ such a beautiful sunset before.
explain: 否定副詞 Never「從未」放句首時需倒裝，助動詞 have 移至主詞 I 前，seen 是 see 的過去分詞。

subject: english
q: ____ it was raining, the players continued the game instead of stopping.
explain: Although 意為「雖然」，可直接接完整子句；despite「儘管」與 because of「因為」後接名詞或動名詞。

subject: english
q: This bag is much ____ than that one.
explain: than 是「比……」，需用比較級 lighter「較輕的」；much 可加強比較級，不能再加 more。

subject: english
q: The classroom must ____ before the visitors arrive.
explain: 教室是被打掃的對象，must 後接原形 be 再加過去分詞 cleaned，表示「必須被打掃」。

subject: english
q: She avoided ____ the question because she did not know the answer.
explain: avoid 意為「避免」，後接動名詞 answering 作受詞，不能接 to answer。

subject: english
q: 'Children' is the plural form of 'child'.
explain: child 意為「小孩」，不規則複數為 children，不是在字尾直接加 s。

subject: english
q: 'She don't like coffee' is grammatically correct in standard written English.
explain: She 是第三人稱單數，否定助動詞須改為 does not 或 doesn't；like coffee 是「喜歡咖啡」。

subject: english
q: In 'Neither of the answers is correct,' the singular verb 'is' is correct.
explain: Neither of 表示「兩者之中沒有一個」；本句用單數動詞 is 正確，answer 是「答案」。

subject: english
q: 'There is few milk left' is grammatically correct in standard written English.
explain: milk「牛奶」是不可數名詞，應改用 little；few 修飾可數複數名詞，兩者均可表示「幾乎沒有」。

subject: english
q: 'She asked where did he live' has correct word order in standard written English.
explain: 間接問句用直述句語序，應為 She asked where he lived；where he lived 意為「他住在哪裡」。

subject: english
q: 'I saw him crossing the street' can describe an action in progress.
explain: 感官動詞 saw 後接受詞與現在分詞 crossing，可表示看見「他正在過馬路」，強調動作進行中。

subject: english
q: In 'She had her bike repaired,' she necessarily repaired the bike herself.
explain: 本句的 have + 受詞 + 過去分詞是使役用法；had her bike repaired 表示「請人修腳踏車」，不能推論是她親自修理。

subject: english
q: The driver checked the brakes ____ before the trip.
explain: 修飾動詞 checked「檢查」須用副詞 carefully「仔細地」；careful 是形容詞，意為「仔細的」。

subject: english
q: Her ____ in the competition made her family proud.
explain: Her ____ in the competition 整體作主詞，空格須填名詞 success「成功」；successful 是形容詞，succeed 是動詞。

subject: english
q: Which word is formed by joining two nouns?
explain: bedroom「臥室」由名詞 bed「床」與 room「房間」組成；其餘分別在字根加上字首 un- 或字尾 -less、-ly。

subject: english
q: To ____ a message is to understand it incorrectly.
explain: misunderstand 意為「誤解」，字首 mis- 表「錯誤地」；misplace 是「放錯地方」，mislead 是「誤導」。

subject: english
q: The suffix '-able' in 'reusable' means ____.
explain: 此處字尾 -able 表示「能被……的」，搭配 reuse「重複使用」，reusable 就是「可重複使用的」。

subject: english
q: Adding '-ment' to 'develop' forms a ____.
explain: develop 是動詞「發展」，加字尾 -ment 成為名詞 development「發展」，noun 就是「名詞」。

subject: english
q: It was ____ of you to lower your voice while the baby was sleeping.
explain: considerate 意為「體貼的」，降低音量是不打擾嬰兒的表現；considerable 是「相當大的」。

subject: english
q: This car is ____ because it uses very little fuel.
explain: 此處用形容詞 economical「節省的」作主詞補語，表示車子省油；economically 是副詞，economy 與 economics 是名詞。

subject: english
q: The word 'abundant' is closest in meaning to ____.
explain: abundant 與 plentiful 都是「充足的、豐富的」；scarce 是「稀少的」，limited 是「有限的」。

subject: english
q: The opposite of 'optimistic' is ____.
explain: optimistic 是「樂觀的」，反義詞為 pessimistic「悲觀的」；realistic 是「務實的」，不必然悲觀。

subject: english
q: The ____ was asked about her work experience during the job interview.
explain: applicant 是「申請者、應徵者」，字尾 -ant 可表示人；application 是名詞「申請、申請書」。

subject: english
q: 'Unhappy' means not happy; 'un-' changes the meaning to its opposite.
explain: unhappy 意為「不快樂的」；此處字首 un- 表示「不」，使 happy「快樂的」變為反義。

subject: english
q: 'Careless' means full of care.
explain: careless 是「粗心的」，字尾 -less 表示「缺乏」；careful 才是「小心的、仔細的」。

subject: english
q: 'Please advice me' uses the correct verb form.
explain: 應改為 Please advise me「請給我建議」；advise 是動詞，advice 則是不可數名詞「建議」。

subject: english
q: 'Obtain' and 'acquire' can both mean get something.
explain: obtain 與 acquire 都可表示「取得、獲得」；兩字在此作動詞，與 get 的這個意思相近。

subject: english
q: A: Could you help me carry this box? B: ____
explain: Sure. Let me help you. 意為「當然，讓我幫你」，適合回應請求；You are welcome. 是「不客氣」。

subject: english
q: A: Thanks for lending me your notes. B: ____
choices: I am sorry to hear that.
explain: You are welcome. 意為「不客氣」，用來回應感謝；lending me your notes 是「借我筆記」。

subject: english
q: We expected the small room to be uncomfortable; ____, we found it pleasant.
explain: however 意為「然而」；預期房間不舒適，實際卻覺得宜人，兩者形成轉折，不能用表因果的 therefore「因此」。

subject: english
q: The last bus had left; ____, we had to walk home.
explain: therefore 意為「因此」；末班公車已離開是走路回家的原因，meanwhile 是「同時」。

subject: english
q: 'Otherwise' in 'Hurry; otherwise, you will miss the train' means ____.
explain: otherwise 意為「否則」，本句指「如果不趕快」就會錯過火車；even if 則是「即使」。

subject: english
q: A: Do you mind if I sit here? B: ____ The seat is free.
choices: Yes, I do. Please find another seat.
I am afraid so. This seat is taken.
Sorry, I am saving it for a friend.
explain: Do you mind ...? 是「你介意……嗎」；Not at all. Go ahead. 表示「完全不介意，請坐」。

subject: english
q: A: I missed the deadline and cannot apply. B: ____
explain: That is a shame. 意為「真可惜」，回應錯過申請期限的遺憾；deadline 是「截止期限」。

subject: english
q: Saying 'I am afraid I cannot' is a polite way to refuse a request.
explain: I am afraid I cannot 意為「恐怕我沒辦法」，可用來委婉拒絕請求，afraid 在此不表示害怕。

subject: english
q: 'In addition' introduces a contrast between two opposing ideas.
explain: in addition 意為「此外」，用來補充資訊；however「然而」才可引出不同想法之間的轉折。

subject: english
q: 'You cannot enter unless you have a ticket' means a ticket is required for entry.
explain: unless 意為「除非、如果不」；本句表示沒有票就不能進入，票是入場必要條件，未保證有票就一定能入場。

subject: english
q: Keep the ____ as proof that you paid for the shoes.
explain: receipt 是「收據」，可作為付款證明；recipe 是「食譜」，容易因拼字相近而混淆。

subject: english
q: The performers bowed to the ____, the people watching the show.
explain: audience 是「觀眾、聽眾」，指觀看表演的人；cast 是「全體演員」，crew 是「工作人員」。

subject: english
q: Too little sleep can ____ your ability to concentrate.
explain: affect 是動詞「影響」；effect 作動詞時是「使發生、實現」，不能表示影響專注能力。

subject: english
q: Our ____ principal retired last year; a new principal now leads the school.
explain: former 在此是「前任的」，指已退休的校長；current 是「現任的」，latter 是「後者的」。

subject: english
q: You need your parents' ____ before joining this overnight trip.
explain: permission 是「許可」，參加過夜旅行須先取得家長同意；prediction 是「預測」。

subject: english
q: Some desert plants ____ to dry conditions by storing water.
explain: adapt to 是「適應」，儲水能幫助植物適應乾燥環境；adopt 是「採用、收養」。

subject: english
q: Human error was the ____ cause, contributing more than any other factor.
explain: principal 作形容詞是「主要的」，符合影響最大的線索；principle 是名詞「原則」，secondary 是「次要的」。

subject: english
q: If I lend you my umbrella, you receive it from me temporarily.
explain: lend 是「借出」，傘由我暫時交給你；borrow 是「借入」，方向相反。

subject: english
q: An expense is money received as payment for work.
explain: expense 是「支出、費用」，不是工作所得；income 才是「收入」。

subject: english
q: The latest news means the most recent news, not necessarily the final news.
explain: latest 是「最新的」，不表示最終一次；final 才是「最後的、最終的」。

subject: english
q: Her explanation was ____; every point connected logically to the next.
explain: coherent 是「連貫的」，各要點有合理連結；contradictory 是「相互矛盾的」。

subject: english
q: The plan is ____, meaning it can actually be carried out with our available resources.
explain: feasible 是「可行的」，表示現有資源足以付諸實行；desirable 是「值得期待的」，不等於做得到。

subject: english
q: The donation was ____; it covered nearly half the hospital's annual costs.
explain: substantial 是「大量的、相當可觀的」，能支付近半年度費用；symbolic 在此是「象徵性的」。

subject: english
q: Without strong passwords, accounts are more ____ to attacks.
explain: vulnerable 是「易受傷害的」，密碼不夠強就容易遭攻擊；resistant 是「有抵抗力的」。

subject: english
q: The rules are ____; they clearly state exactly what visitors may do.
explain: explicit 是「明確的、明白表達的」；implicit 是「隱含的」，ambiguous 是「模稜兩可的」。

subject: english
q: The final point was ____ because it decided who won the match.
explain: crucial 是「關鍵的」，最後一分決定勝負；minor 是「次要的」，optional 是「非必要的」。

subject: english
q: Unlike the plain entrance, the ceiling had ____ patterns with hundreds of tiny details.
explain: elaborate 作形容詞是「精細複雜的」，符合大量細節；crude 是「粗糙的」，plain 是「樸素的」。

subject: english
q: The editor wanted to ____ the photograph's quality, making it better than before.
explain: enhance 是「提升、增強」，此處指改善照片品質；assess 是「評估」，maintain 是「維持」。

subject: english
q: The school will ____ its approved recycling plan by placing bins in every classroom.
explain: implement 是「實施」；在每間教室放置回收桶是落實計畫的具體行動，postpone 是「延後」。

subject: english
q: Repeated broken promises can ____ trust, even if each promise seems small.
explain: undermine 是「逐漸損害、削弱」，屢次失信會破壞信任；reinforce 是「加強」，restore 是「恢復」。

subject: english
q: Clear signs ____ travel by helping visitors find their way quickly.
explain: facilitate 是「使更容易、促進」，清楚標示能讓旅行更便利；complicate 是「使複雜化」。

subject: english
q: We ____ heavy traffic tomorrow, so we plan to leave early.
explain: anticipate 是「預期」，先預料塞車而提早出發；recall 是「回想」，overlook 是「忽略」。

subject: english
q: The airline paid money to ____ passengers for their lost luggage.
explain: compensate 是「補償」，航空公司因行李遺失付錢給乘客；charge 是「收費」，fine 是「罰款」。

subject: english
q: Both sides gave up some demands to reach a ____.
explain: compromise 是「妥協、折衷」，雙方各自讓步以達成協議；command 是「命令」。

subject: english
q: The manager must ____ the budget among three departments.
explain: allocate 是「分配」，預算要分給三個部門；calculate 是「計算」，accumulate 是「累積」。

subject: english
q: During the serious speech, Leo tried to ____ a laugh by covering his mouth.
explain: suppress 是「抑制」，遮嘴是為了忍住笑；provoke 是「引起」，imitate 是「模仿」。

subject: english
q: To keep its meal service running at the present level, the charity needs funds to ____ it.
explain: sustain 是「維持」，指讓服務以現有規模繼續運作；suspend 是「暫停」，launch 是「開始推行」。

subject: english
q: After years of conflict, the brothers finally managed to ____ and become friends again.
explain: reconcile 在此是「和解」，兄弟衝突後恢復友好；retaliate 是「報復」，separate 是「分開」。

subject: english
q: The scientist chose to ____ her mistake by openly admitting that she had made it.
explain: acknowledge 是「承認」；openly admitting「公開承認」直接說明字義，justify 是「為……辯護」，不等於認錯。

subject: english
q: Lena was ____ of the claim, doubting it until she saw evidence that it was true.
explain: skeptical 是「懷疑的」，取得可靠證據前不輕信；convinced 是「確信的」。

subject: english
q: The illness is highly ____, so it can spread easily from person to person.
explain: contagious 是「有傳染性的」，指容易在人與人之間傳播；chronic 是「慢性的」，fatal 是「致命的」。

subject: english
q: Every detail was checked through ____ testing before the device went on sale.
explain: rigorous 是「嚴謹的」，逐項檢查細節符合嚴格測試；superficial 是「表面的、不深入的」。

subject: english
q: To stay financially ____, the store must earn enough to cover its running costs.
explain: viable 在此是「能持續經營的」，營收須足以支應營運成本；vulnerable 是「易受傷害的」。

subject: english
q: These medical records are ____; only authorized staff may read them.
explain: confidential 是「機密的」，只有獲授權的人能閱覽；accessible 是「可取得、可使用的」。

subject: english
q: The vote was ____; every member supported the proposal.
explain: unanimous 是「全體一致的」，所有成員都支持；divided 是「意見分歧的」。

subject: english
q: The customer returned extra change nobody had noticed, showing ____.
explain: integrity 是「正直、誠信」，無人察覺仍歸還多找的錢；vanity 是「虛榮」，hostility 是「敵意」。

subject: english
q: Judging applicants by gender rather than ability shows ____.
explain: prejudice 是「偏見」，以性別而非能力判斷應徵者並不公平；expertise 是「專業知識」。

subject: english
q: A trivial error is an extremely serious error.
explain: trivial 是「微不足道的、不重要的」，不是 extremely serious「極嚴重的」。

subject: english
q: A tentative plan may still change before it becomes final.
explain: tentative 是「暫定的、尚未確定的」，計畫在定案前仍可能調整；final 是「最終的、確定的」。

subject: english
q: Innovation means copying an old method without changing anything.
explain: innovation 是「創新」，涉及新方法或新想法，不是完全照抄舊方法。

subject: english
q: A dilemma can involve choosing between two equally unpleasant options.
explain: dilemma 是「兩難」，可指必須在兩個都不理想的選項之間抉擇；unpleasant 是「令人不快的」。

subject: english
q: A consensus is a general agreement within a group.
explain: consensus 是「共識」，指團體形成大致一致的看法；general agreement 是「普遍的認同」。

subject: english
q: Winning on three consecutive days means winning on three days in a row.
explain: consecutive 是「連續的」，in a row 也是「連續地」，中間沒有間隔日。

subject: english
q: Plants indigenous to an island occur there naturally rather than being introduced by people.
explain: indigenous 是「原生的、當地固有的」，指自然存在於當地；introduced 在此是「人為引入的」。

subject: english
q: A spontaneous decision is always carefully planned weeks in advance.
explain: spontaneous 是「自發的、未經事先安排的」，不是提前數週縝密規劃；in advance 是「事先」。

subject: english
q: A compulsory course is one students are required to take.
explain: compulsory 是「必須的、強制的」，compulsory course 就是「必修課」。

subject: english
q: To act without consent is to act with permission.
explain: consent 是「同意、許可」，without consent 是「未經同意」，不是獲得許可。

subject: english
q: Our picnic plans depend ____ the weather.
explain: depend on 意為「取決於、依靠」，此處表示野餐計畫取決於天氣，介系詞用 on。

subject: english
q: Please ____ attention to the safety instructions.
explain: pay attention to 是「注意」的固定搭配；instructions 是「指示、說明」。

subject: english
q: The scientists will ____ the experiment exactly as planned.
explain: carry out 意為「執行、進行」，可搭配 experiment「實驗」；carry over 是「延續、留到之後」。

subject: english
q: With rent rising, the family struggles to ____ on one salary.
explain: make ends meet 是「使收支平衡」，一家人靠一份薪水難以維持生計；salary 是「薪水」。

subject: english
q: If you delete a file by accident, you delete it deliberately.
explain: by accident 是「意外地、無意間」，不是 deliberately「故意地」。

subject: english
q: Success at the expense of health means success gained while harming health.
explain: at the expense of 是「以……為代價」，表示成功伴隨健康受損；harming 是「傷害」。

subject: english
q: The prefix in disapprove changes approve to mean ____.
explain: dis- 在 disapprove「不贊同」中表示否定；approve 是「贊同、核准」。

subject: english
q: The city plans to ____ this narrow road.
explain: plan to 後接原形動詞；widen 是「拓寬」，由 wide「寬的」加字尾 -en 構成。

subject: english
q: Her ____ made the frightened child feel welcome.
explain: 所有格 Her 後需名詞 kindness「親切、善意」作主詞；-ness 可把形容詞 kind 轉為名詞。

subject: english
q: Regular exercise can increase muscle ____.
explain: muscle strength 是「肌力」，此處需名詞 strength「力量」；strengthen 是動詞「增強」。

subject: english
q: He could ____ hear the speaker because the microphone was broken.
explain: hardly 是「幾乎不」，符合麥克風壞掉而聽不清楚的情境；hard 作副詞是「努力地」。

subject: english
q: Replacing the damaged engine was a ____ repair.
explain: 修飾名詞 repair「修理」需形容詞 costly「昂貴的」；不是所有 -ly 結尾的字都是副詞。

subject: english
q: The root bio- in biology refers to ____.
explain: 字根 bio- 表示「生命」，biology 是「生物學」；-logy 表示某門學問。

subject: english
q: To redo a task is to do it again.
explain: redo 是「重做」，字首 re- 表示「再次」，task 是「任務」。

subject: english
q: Independent means relying on others for support.
explain: independent 是「獨立的、不依賴的」；dependent 才是「依賴的」，此處字首 in- 表示否定。

subject: english
q: 'Invaluable' means extremely useful or valuable, rather than worthless.
explain: invaluable 是「極有價值的、無價的」，不是「沒有價值」；worthless 才是「無價值的」。

subject: english
q: On weekdays, Ray usually ____ the bus to school.
explain: usually「通常」表示習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 Ray 為第三人稱單數，動詞用 takes「搭乘」。

subject: english
q: At the moment the lights went out, we ____ dinner.
explain: 停電是過去某一瞬間，當時吃晚餐正在進行，用過去進行式 were eating「正在吃」。

subject: english
q: She ____ for two hours and is still running.
explain: for two hours「持續兩小時」且現在仍在跑，用現在完成進行式 has been running 強調持續中的活動。

subject: english
q: By next Friday, we ____ all ten chapters.
explain: by next Friday 是「到下週五為止」，用未來完成式 will have finished 表示屆時已完成。

subject: english
q: These rooms ____ every morning by the cleaning staff.
explain: 房間是「被打掃」，且 every morning「每天早上」表示例行工作，用現在簡單式被動 are cleaned。

subject: english
q: At noon yesterday, the bridge ____ by a repair crew.
explain: 橋梁是「被修理」，過去中午正在施工，用過去進行式被動 was being repaired。

subject: english
q: The missing keys ____ already ____ by the guard.
explain: keys「鑰匙」是複數且被警衛找到，用現在完成式被動 have been found；already 是「已經」。

subject: english
q: This time tomorrow, we ____ to Taipei by train.
explain: this time tomorrow「明天這個時候」表示未來某時正在進行的動作，用未來進行式 will be traveling「將正在前往」。

subject: english
q: A number of students ____ waiting outside now.
explain: a number of 是「許多」，後接複數名詞時動詞用複數 are；the number of「……的數量」才用單數。

subject: english
q: 'The news are encouraging' has correct subject-verb agreement.
explain: news「消息」雖以 s 結尾，仍用單數動詞 is；encouraging 是「令人振奮的」。

subject: english
q: 'The police is investigating' uses the correct verb in standard written English.
explain: police「警方」作主詞時用複數動詞，應為 The police are investigating「警方正在調查」。

subject: english
q: 'Ella has been to Kyoto' can mean she visited Kyoto and has returned.
explain: have been to 表示「曾去過」某地，通常已返回；have gone to 表示「已前往」而尚未回來。

subject: english
q: In 'She used to live here,' used to describes a present habit.
explain: used to 加原形動詞表示「過去曾經、過去常常」，本句是過去住這裡，不是現在的習慣。

subject: english
q: This is the café ____ we first met.
explain: café「咖啡館」是地點，子句 we first met 不缺主詞或受詞，用關係副詞 where 表「在那裡」。

subject: english
q: I remember the day ____ we first spoke to each other.
explain: 先行詞 the day「那一天」表示時間，子句不缺主詞或受詞，用關係副詞 when「在那時」。

subject: english
q: The reason ____ she left remains unknown.
explain: the reason 後用關係副詞 why 說明「……的原因」；remains unknown 是「仍然不明」。

subject: english
q: In formal English: The teacher to ____ I spoke was helpful.
explain: 介系詞 to 後指人的關係代名詞用 whom「誰」，不能用 that；spoke to 是「與……交談」。

subject: english
q: I understood ____ you said, but I disagreed.
explain: what 相當於 the thing that「……的事」，兼作名詞子句引導詞與 said 的受詞，不需另加先行詞。

subject: english
q: Our decision depends on ____ we can get enough support.
explain: 介系詞 on 後表示「是否」用 whether，不用 if；get enough support 是「獲得足夠支持」。

subject: english
q: ____ arrives first may choose a seat.
explain: Whoever 是「任何……的人」，在子句中作 arrives 的主詞；Whomever 為受格，不能作此主詞。

subject: english
q: Keep stirring ____ the sugar has completely dissolved; then stop.
explain: until 是「直到」，表示攪拌持續到糖完全溶解才停止；dissolved 是「溶解了」。

subject: english
q: To show simultaneous actions: Dad cooked ____ Mom washed the dishes.
explain: while 在此是「當……的同時」，連接同時進行的活動；simultaneous 是「同時發生的」。

subject: english
q: To state the purpose: Speak clearly ____ everyone can hear you.
explain: so that 表示「以便」，引出說清楚的目的；even though 是「雖然、儘管」，now that 是「既然」。

subject: english
q: To express a precaution: Take a spare key ____ you lose the original.
explain: in case 是「以防」，先帶備用鑰匙預防原鑰匙遺失；spare key 是「備用鑰匙」。

subject: english
q: She neither called ____ sent a message.
explain: neither ... nor ... 是「既不……也不……」，連接兩個並列動作；sent a message 是「傳了訊息」。

subject: english
q: The fact ____ he apologized surprised me.
explain: that 引導同位語子句，說明 fact「事實」的內容，不在子句中作成分；apologized 是「道歉了」。

subject: english
q: ____ tired you are, you must check the lock.
explain: No matter how 加形容詞表示「無論多麼……」；tired 是「疲倦的」，how 用來修飾程度。

subject: english
q: In 'The book I borrowed is interesting,' a relative pronoun has been omitted.
explain: book「書」是 borrowed 的受詞，限定關係子句的受格關係代名詞 that 或 which 可以省略。

subject: english
q: In 'He arrived late, which upset us,' 'which' refers only to the person who arrived.
explain: which 指前面「他遲到」整件事，這件事讓我們不高興，不是只指 he「他」這個人。

subject: english
q: In 'The task was hard, but I finished it,' but signals a contrast.
explain: but 是「但是」，連接任務困難與仍完成的對比；task 是「任務」。

subject: english
q: 'Both Tom and Amy came' means Tom came but Amy did not.
explain: both ... and ... 是「……和……兩者都」，本句表示湯姆與艾咪都有來。

subject: english
q: 'Whether Mia agrees or not, we will leave' means we will leave only if she agrees.
explain: whether ... or not 在此是「不論是否」，表示無論米雅同不同意都會離開，並非以同意為條件。

subject: english
q: We went to the station ____ our guests.
explain: to meet 是表目的的不定詞，表示「為了迎接」客人；went 是主要動詞，不能直接再接原形 meet。

subject: english
q: Could you show me how ____ this app?
explain: how to use 是「如何使用」，疑問詞 how 後可接不定詞，整體作 show 的受詞。

subject: english
q: Let me ____ the answer before you explain it.
explain: 使役動詞 let 後接「受詞加原形動詞」，Let me guess 是「讓我猜猜」。

subject: english
q: The students were made ____ the room after the activity.
explain: make 的使役句改為被動時須補回 to：were made to clean 是「被要求打掃」。

subject: english
q: Remember ____ the door before you leave; it is still unlocked.
explain: remember to lock 是「記得去鎖」，門尚未鎖，動作未做；remember locking 是「記得曾鎖過」。

subject: english
q: It is important ____ calm during an emergency.
explain: It 是虛主詞，真正主詞為不定詞片語 to stay calm「保持冷靜」；句意是緊急時保持冷靜很重要。

subject: english
q: They persuaded me ____ the school choir.
explain: persuade someone to V 是「說服某人做……」；choir 是「合唱團」。

subject: english
q: ____ every day improves your balance.
explain: Practicing 是動名詞，可作主詞，表示「每天練習」這件事；balance 在此是「平衡感」。

subject: english
q: The boy ____ by the window is my cousin.
explain: standing by the window 是「站在窗邊的」，現在分詞片語修飾 boy，等於 who is standing。

subject: english
q: The bridge ____ last year is now open.
explain: bridge「橋」是被建造的，用過去分詞 built 修飾，等於 which was built；last year 是「去年」。

subject: english
q: She seems ____ the news already; she knew every detail.
explain: to have heard 是完成式不定詞，表示「似乎已經聽說」，聽到消息早於目前的判斷。

subject: english
q: Which sentence avoids a dangling participle?
choices: Walking home, the sky turned dark.
Walking home, the streetlights came on.
Walking home, I saw a rainbow.
Walking home, the bus was late.
explain: 分詞構句的隱含主詞須與主句主詞一致；Walking home 是「走路回家」，能做此動作的是 I「我」。

subject: english
q: In 'The plan is worth trying,' 'trying' is the correct form after 'worth'.
explain: be worth V-ing 表示「值得……」，worth 後接動名詞；worth trying 是「值得嘗試」。

subject: english
q: 'This shirt needs washing' can mean 'This shirt needs to be washed'.
explain: need 後接動名詞可表被動；needs washing 等於 needs to be washed「需要清洗」。

subject: english
q: In 'Would you mind my opening the window?' 'my' identifies the person who would open it.
explain: 動名詞 opening 前的所有格 my 表示開窗的人是「我」；此句是在問對方是否介意我開窗。

subject: english
q: 'He asked me not to leave' means he asked me to depart.
explain: not to leave 是「不要離開」，與 depart「離開」相反；不定詞否定式可將 not 放在 to 前。

subject: english
q: In 'The book is easy to read,' 'read' must be changed to 'be read'.
explain: easy to read 是「容易閱讀」；此句用主動形式的不定詞描述書被閱讀，不必改成 to be read。

subject: english
q: I wish I ____ my umbrella yesterday; I got soaked.
explain: 對過去的事表示遺憾，wish 後用過去完成式 had brought「當時有帶」；got soaked 是「淋濕了」。

subject: english
q: If I had accepted that job last year, I ____ in Tokyo now.
explain: 條件是假設過去接受工作，結果是假設現在的所在地，屬混合假設句，主句用 would be「現在會在」。

subject: english
q: ____ I known about the delay, I would have left later.
explain: Had I known 等於 If I had known「如果我當時知道」，省略 if 時將 had 移到主詞前。

subject: english
q: I would rather you ____ here tonight instead of driving home.
explain: would rather 加另一主詞時，表達現在或未來的偏好用過去式 stayed，意為「我寧願你留下」。

subject: english
q: It is time we ____ home; it is getting late.
explain: It is time 加主詞與過去式，表示「該……了」，此處是現在該回家，不是敘述過去。

subject: english
q: Use the subjunctive for a recommendation: The doctor suggested that he ____ more water.
explain: 題目指定建議句的假設語氣，that 子句用原形動詞 drink「喝」，也可用 should drink。

subject: english
q: It was Mia ____ found the missing key.
explain: It was ... that ... 是強調句型，強調 Mia「米雅」找到鑰匙；此處 that 在子句中作主詞。

subject: english
q: The more you practice, ____ you become.
explain: the 加比較級的兩個子句搭配，表示「越……越……」；the better 是「越好」。

subject: english
q: She is one of the ____ players on the team.
explain: one of the 加最高級與複數名詞，表示「最……的其中之一」；good 的最高級是不規則變化 best，不說 goodest 或 most good。

subject: english
q: You had better ____ now, or you will be late.
explain: had better 加原形動詞，表示「最好……」；leave now 是「現在離開」。

subject: english
q: The box is too heavy for me ____ alone.
explain: too ... to V 是「太……而無法……」；for me 指動作者，to lift alone 是「獨自抬起」。

subject: english
q: You have finished the task, ____ you?
explain: 肯定句的附加問句通常用否定形式；主句用 have 構成現在完成式，因此用 haven't you「你已完成，對吧」。

subject: english
q: In 'Sam can swim, and I can too,' swim is omitted after the second can.
explain: 第二個 can 後省略重複的 swim「游泳」，I can too 表示「我也會」，是助動詞後的省略。

subject: english
q: 'Not all students agreed' means no students agreed.
explain: not all 是「並非全部」，屬部分否定，不能等同 no students「沒有任何學生」。

subject: english
q: 'I would rather to walk than drive' is grammatically correct.
explain: would rather 後接原形 walk，不加 to；would rather walk than drive 是「寧願走路也不開車」。

subject: english
q: If no runner is faster than Jane, Jane must be faster than every other runner.
explain: no runner is faster 是「沒有跑者比她快」，仍可能有人與她同速，不能推論她是唯一最快的跑者。

subject: english
q: I did not order coffee. ____, I chose tea.
explain: instead 是「改為、反而」，表示以茶取代咖啡；otherwise 是「否則」，similarly 是「同樣地」。

subject: english
q: Nina plans her study time and finishes tasks before deadlines. Which statement best sums this up?
choices: Nina always works faster than others.
Nina manages her study time well.
explain: 安排讀書時間並在期限前完成工作，重點是善於管理時間；其餘選項加入文中未提的休息、考前讀書或速度比較。

subject: english
q: I stirred the soup. ____, my sister was setting the table at that very moment.
explain: meanwhile 是「與此同時」，描述兩人同時做不同工作；set the table 是「擺餐具」。

subject: english
q: Some metals are attracted to magnets. ____, iron is one such metal.
explain: for example 是「例如」，用鐵作為前句的實例；magnets 是「磁鐵」，by contrast 是「相較之下」。

subject: english
q: The service is available around the clock. ____, it operates twenty-four hours a day.
explain: in other words 是「換句話說」，後句重新解釋 around the clock「全天候」，不是因果或相反說法。

subject: english
q: A sign says, 'Wet paint. Please do not touch the bench.' What is its purpose?
choices: To warn people about wet paint
To invite people to help paint
To sell a newly painted bench
explain: 告示提醒人們不要碰油漆未乾的長椅，目的是警告；warn 是「警告、提醒」，不是招募、課程或商品廣告。

subject: english
q: I put wet towels beside dry shirts. They still needed drying. 'They' refers to ____.
explain: They 指「濕毛巾」，因為仍需晾乾；dry shirts 是「乾襯衫」，不符合仍需乾燥的語意。

subject: english
q: The river flooded the street. This forced residents to leave. 'This' refers to ____.
explain: This 指前句「河水淹沒街道」這件事，導致居民離開；flooding 是「淹水」，不是指居民本身。

subject: english
q: The trail is closed after the storm. ____. Please choose another route.
choices: The mountain is famous for its sunrise
The park opens early every morning
explain: 「倒下的樹擋住步道」能解釋封閉與改道的原因，連貫前後句；trail、path 都可指「步道」。

subject: english
q: 'In conclusion' usually introduces a summary near the end of a text.
explain: in conclusion 是「總而言之、最後」，常在文章末段引出總結，不是用來列舉個別例子。

subject: english
q: In 'Lina lost her gloves, so she bought new ones,' ones refers to gloves.
explain: ones 代替前面出現的複數名詞 gloves「手套」，new ones 是「新的手套」，避免重複。

subject: english
q: Afterwards signals that an event happened before the event just mentioned.
explain: afterwards 是「之後、後來」，表示接下來的事件；before 是「在……之前」，時間順序相反。

subject: english
q: Handle this glass bowl gently; it is ____ and may break easily.
explain: fragile 是「易碎的」，玻璃碗容易破裂，所以要輕拿輕放；flexible 是「可彎曲的」，solid 是「堅固的」。

subject: english
q: Only staff have ____ to these files; visitors cannot open them.
explain: access 是「使用或存取的權限」，只有員工能開啟檔案；progress 是「進展」，excess 是「過量」。

subject: english
q: The hotel will ____ guests an extra fee for parking overnight.
explain: charge 是「向……收費」，charge someone a fee 表示向某人收取費用；spend 是「花費」，earn 是「賺得」。

subject: english
q: After weeks of practice, Mia felt ____ that she could give the speech successfully.
explain: confident 是「有信心的」，練習後相信能順利演講；arrogant 是「傲慢的」，anxious 是「焦慮的」。

subject: english
q: The medicine can ____ pain, reducing its severity without curing the illness.
explain: relieve 是「緩解、減輕」；reducing its severity 指降低疼痛程度，不能選 cause「造成」。減輕疼痛不等於治癒疾病。

subject: english
q: When memorizing lists failed, she tried a new ____ to learning words: using them in stories.
explain: approach 在此是「方法」，以故事學單字是新的學習方式；attitude 是「態度」，objection 是「反對意見」。

subject: english
q: The pilot explained the safety checks to ____ nervous passengers that they were in good hands.
explain: reassure 是「使安心」，說明安全檢查是為了安撫乘客；alarm 是「使驚慌」，deceive 是「欺騙」。

subject: english
q: Which verb means 'to become smaller or weaker'?
explain: diminish 是「減少、減弱」；persist 是「持續存在」，intensify 是「加劇」，emerge 是「出現」，都不等於變小或變弱。

subject: english
q: Matching evidence from independent sources made the witness's account more ____.
explain: credible 是「可信的」，獨立來源的證據吻合可增加可信度；dubious 是「可疑的」，imaginary 是「想像的、虛構的」。

subject: english
q: Unlike a brief overview, the report is ____; it covers every stage and every possible risk.
explain: comprehensive 是「全面的」，強調涵蓋所有階段與風險；selective 是「有選擇的」，partial 是「部分的」。

subject: english
q: The artist chose to ____ village life through paintings rather than describe it in words.
explain: depict 是「描繪」，此處用畫作呈現村莊生活；predict 是「預測」，prescribe 是「開處方、規定」。

subject: english
q: The witness agreed to ____ the suspect's hiding place instead of keeping it secret.
explain: disclose 是「揭露、公開」，與保密相反；conceal 是「隱瞞」，disguise 是「偽裝」，distort 是「扭曲」。

subject: english
q: Please ____ your shoes before entering the house; leave them by the door.
explain: take off 是「脫下」，鞋子要留在門邊；take over 是「接管」，take back 是「收回」。

subject: english
q: To save electricity, our family decided to ____ air conditioning by using fans more often.
explain: cut down on 是「減少」，多用電扇以減少冷氣使用；catch up on 是「補做、補上」，hold on to 是「保留」。

subject: english
q: The author accused the company ____ copying her work without permission.
explain: accuse someone of 是「指控某人……」，of 後接 copying「抄襲」；不要和 charge someone with 的搭配混淆。

subject: english
q: The principal will ____ a speech at the graduation ceremony.
explain: deliver a speech 是「發表演說」的搭配；tell 後常接人或故事，talk 不能直接接 a speech。

subject: english
q: The missing receipts ____ the difference between our records and the bank statement.
explain: account for 在此是「解釋……的原因」，遺漏收據能說明帳目差額；count on 是「依靠」，result from 是「起因於」。

subject: english
q: If you learn a poem by heart, you memorize it.
explain: learn by heart 是「背熟、記住」，memorize 是「熟記」；不是指理解詩中的情感。

subject: english
q: Being on the same page about a plan means disagreeing about its main points.
explain: be on the same page 是「有相同理解、有共識」，不是對計畫重點意見不合；disagree 是「不同意」。

subject: english
q: To preheat an oven is to heat it ____ cooking.
explain: pre- 表示「事先」，preheat 是「預熱」，也就是烹調前先加熱；oven 是「烤箱」。

subject: english
q: The town will ____ its old factories by adding modern equipment.
explain: will 後接原形動詞 modernize「使現代化」，-ize 可形成動詞；modern 是「現代的」，modernization 是名詞「現代化」。

subject: english
q: In portable, the root port relates to ____.
explain: 字根 port 有「攜帶、搬運」的意思，portable 是「可攜帶的」；不是指港口的名詞 port。

subject: english
q: Which noun is formed from decide by changing its ending?
explain: decide「決定」對應的名詞是 decision「決定」；-sion 是常見名詞字尾，decisive 則是形容詞「果斷的」。

subject: english
q: The prefix inter- in international means ____.
explain: inter- 在此表示「在……之間」；international 是「國際的」，指國與國之間的。

subject: english
q: The suffix -hood in childhood forms a noun naming a ____.
explain: -hood 在此表示「時期、階段」，childhood 是「童年」；不是表示人物、地點或動作方式。

subject: english
q: Antiwar describes opposition to war.
explain: anti- 表示「反對、對抗」，antiwar 是「反戰的」；opposition 是「反對」。

subject: english
q: To underestimate a cost is to judge it as higher than it really is.
explain: underestimate 是「低估」，判斷的費用比實際低；overestimate 才是「高估」，under- 在此表示不足。

subject: english
q: In 'a novel approach,' novel is used as a noun.
explain: novel 在此修飾名詞 approach「方法」，是形容詞「新穎的」；作名詞時才指「小說」。

subject: english
q: Neither the players nor their coach ____ ready yet.
explain: neither ... nor ... 是「既不……也不……」，動詞與較近的主詞一致；coach「教練」是單數，故用 is。

subject: english
q: The teacher, along with two students, ____ presenting the results now.
explain: along with 是「連同」，不改變主詞 teacher「老師」的單數性；now「現在」配合 is presenting 表示正在報告。

subject: english
q: Ten kilometers ____ too far for this beginner to run without a rest.
explain: Ten kilometers「十公里」在此視為一整段距離，動詞用單數 is；beginner 是「初學者」。

subject: english
q: The parcel is already here; it must ____ delivered while we were out.
explain: must have been delivered 是「當時一定已被送達」，以完成式被動推測過去；parcel 是「包裹」。

subject: english
q: She ____ the answer now, so there is no need to explain again.
explain: know「知道」是狀態動詞，此處用現在簡單式 knows，不用 is knowing；主詞 She 搭配第三人稱單數。

subject: english
q: When our bus finally arrived, we ____ for an hour in the rain.
explain: 等車持續到公車抵達這個過去時間點，用 had been waiting「當時已持續等候」；不是延續到現在。

subject: english
q: Every desk and chair ____ labeled with a student's name.
explain: Every desk and chair 表示「每張桌子與每張椅子」，each、every 限定的此類並列主詞用單數動詞 is。

subject: english
q: I ____ call you last night, but my phone ran out of power before I could.
explain: was going to 表示「當時原本打算」，配合昨晚想打電話卻沒電的情境；run out of power 是「電力耗盡」。

subject: english
q: 'I am belonged to by this bag' is a correct passive form of 'This bag belongs to me'.
explain: belong to 是「屬於」，belong 為不及物動詞，不能改成 am belonged；原句表示這個包包屬於我。

subject: english
q: 'My scissors is on the desk' has correct subject-verb agreement.
explain: scissors「剪刀」作主詞搭配複數動詞，應用 are；若主詞是 a pair of scissors「一把剪刀」，才用 is。

subject: english
q: In 'By noon, I will have been working for six hours,' the working period extends up to a future point.
explain: will have been working 是未來完成進行式，表示持續工作到未來中午時已滿六小時；by noon 是「到中午為止」。

subject: english
q: The course teaches not only grammar ____ pronunciation.
explain: not only ... but also ... 是「不僅……而且……」，此處連接 grammar「文法」與 pronunciation「發音」兩個並列名詞。

subject: english
q: The lake ____ we visited last summer is now frozen.
explain: visited「造訪」後缺受詞，即使 lake「湖」是地點，仍用關係代名詞 which；where 不能作 visited 的受詞。

subject: english
q: To set a condition: You may join us ____ you follow the safety rules.
explain: as long as 在此是「只要」，引出參加的條件；even if 是「即使」，as though 是「彷彿」。

subject: english
q: We chose to repair the chair ____ throw it away.
explain: rather than 是「而不是」，連接 repair「修理」與 throw away「丟棄」兩項動作；其餘選項後需完整子句。

subject: english
q: She spoke ____ quietly that only the front row could hear her.
explain: so 加形容詞或副詞，再接 that 子句表示「如此……以致……」；quietly 是「小聲地」，such 主要搭配名詞。

subject: english
q: 'Since we are all here, let's begin' uses since to give a reason.
explain: since 在此是「既然、因為」，用全員到齊作為開始的理由；不表示「自從」某個時間點。

subject: english
q: In 'That he lied is obvious,' the initial That can be omitted in standard written English.
explain: That he lied「他說謊這件事」是整個句子的主詞，開頭的 that 不能省略；obvious 是「明顯的」。

subject: english
q: To announce bad news: We regret ____ you that your application was unsuccessful.
explain: regret to inform 是「很遺憾地通知」，用來宣告壞消息；regret informing 則是「後悔曾通知」。

subject: english
q: Taking this job means ____ to another city, so consider the move carefully.
explain: mean V-ing 是「意味著、必須伴隨……」，接下工作就得搬家；mean to V 則是「打算做……」，表示意圖。

subject: english
q: It was generous ____ you to share your lunch with me.
explain: generous「慷慨的」評述人的特質，用 It is + 形容詞 + of someone + to V；此處是稱讚你願意分享午餐。

subject: english
q: The coach kept the players ____ until sunset.
explain: keep + 受詞 + V-ing 表示「讓……持續做……」；球員主動練習，故用 practicing，until sunset 是「直到日落」。

subject: english
q: She was the first student ____ the puzzle without help.
explain: the first student to solve 是「第一位解開的學生」，序數修飾的名詞後常以不定詞說明動作；puzzle 是「謎題」。

subject: english
q: ____ a map, we had to ask a passerby for directions.
explain: Not having a map 是「因為沒有地圖」，否定分詞構句將 not 放在分詞前；passerby 是「路人」。

subject: english
q: In 'I hurried to the station, only to find the train had left,' the infinitive gives an unexpected result.
explain: only to find 表示「結果卻發現」，不定詞在此引出意料之外的結果；不是趕往車站的目的。

subject: english
q: In 'He stopped to answer the phone,' he stopped another activity so he could answer.
explain: stop to V 是「停下原來的活動，以便做另一件事」，此處是停下來接電話；stop answering 才是「停止接聽」。

subject: english
q: 'I am used to working late' describes something I am accustomed to, rather than a former habit.
explain: be used to V-ing 是「習慣於……」，to 為介系詞；used to V 才表示「過去常常」，兩者句構不同。

subject: english
q: 'But for your help, we would have failed.' What does but for mean here?
explain: but for 在此等於 without「若沒有、要不是」，引出與過去事實相反的條件；本句表示有了你的幫忙才沒有失敗。

subject: english
q: I wish you ____ interrupting me; I cannot finish a sentence.
explain: wish you would stop 表示「希望你別再……」，盼望對方改變當下持續的行為；interrupt 是「打斷」。

subject: english
q: You may doubt her, but she ____ tell the truth yesterday.
explain: did 加原形 tell 可強調「確實說了」，配合 yesterday「昨天」；不是否定句，也不是疑問句。

subject: english
q: So difficult ____ that nobody finished it.
explain: So difficult 置於句首加強程度時，be 動詞移到主詞前，成為 So difficult was the test；difficult 是「困難的」。

subject: english
q: This year's fee is twice ____ last year's.
explain: 倍數比較用 twice as much as「為……的兩倍」，fee「費用」比較金額，用 much，不用比較數量的 many。

subject: english
q: The climate of Taipei is warmer than ____ of Tokyo.
explain: that 代替前面的單數名詞 climate「氣候」，比較臺北與東京的氣候；不能直接把氣候與城市相比。

subject: english
q: When ____ by reporters about the accident, she refused to comment.
explain: When asked 是 When she was asked「當她被問到時」的省略形式；她是被詢問的一方，故用 asked。

subject: english
q: In 'Come as early as possible,' the phrase asks for the earliest time that is possible.
explain: as early as possible 是「盡早」，指在可行範圍內越早越好；不是要求比所有其他人都早。

subject: english
q: In 'What I need is a break,' the sentence emphasizes the thing I need.
explain: What I need is ... 是分裂句，聚焦「我所需要的」事物；a break 是「休息」，不是強調需要休息的人是誰。

subject: english
q: After 'I cannot swim,' 'So can I' expresses the same negative meaning.
explain: 附和否定句應說 Neither can I「我也不會」；So can I 是「我也會」，用來附和肯定句。

subject: english
q: A: This room is empty. B: ____, someone is already sleeping here.
explain: on the contrary 是「正好相反」，B 以有人在睡覺反駁 A 說房間無人的說法；in the meantime 是「在此期間」。

subject: english
q: I enjoy hiking and cycling, but prefer the latter. I prefer ____.
explain: the latter 是「後者」，在 hiking「健行」與 cycling「騎自行車」兩項中指第二項 cycling。

subject: english
q: 'Mia told Zoe that she had won.' Without more context, she could refer to ____.
explain: she「她」可能指米雅，也可能指柔伊；本句缺少可排除其中一人的線索，不能只因距離近就認定是柔伊。

subject: english
q: Some volunteers sorted books; the rest packed boxes. The rest refers to ____.
explain: the rest 是「其餘的人或物」，此處與 some volunteers「部分志工」對應，指剩下的志工，而不是剩下的書。

subject: english
q: Some students need quiet study. ____. A shared space should offer both.
choices: Quiet students dislike all shared spaces
explain: both「兩者」需要對應兩種需求，填入「其他學生透過討論學得最好」才能連結安靜與討論兩種學習方式。

subject: english
q: The writer claims an app saves time. Which detail best supports this claim?
choices: Users can choose among several fonts
The app was released last year
Users finish the same task in half the time
The app has many different features
explain: 同一項工作只花一半時間，可直接支持 saves time「節省時間」；字型、功能數量與推出年份都未證明省時。

subject: english
q: On the one hand often prepares readers for a contrasting side introduced by on the other hand.
explain: on the one hand「一方面」常與 on the other hand「另一方面」配對，呈現同一議題不同或相對的面向。

subject: english
q: Using perhaps shows certainty that an event will happen.
explain: perhaps 是「也許」，保留不確定性；certainty 是「確定」，不能把可能發生讀成必定發生。

subject: english
q: In 'I agree to some extent,' the speaker expresses complete agreement.
explain: to some extent 是「在某種程度上」，表示部分同意；complete agreement 才是「完全同意」。

subject: english
q: If two events happen together, a text has proved that one caused the other.
explain: happen together 是「一起發生」，僅有這項資訊不能證明因果；caused 是「導致」，還需要支持因果關係的證據。

subject: english
q: A topic sentence states a paragraph's main idea; the other sentences should develop that idea.
explain: topic sentence 是「主題句」，提出段落中心；其他句子應以說明、理由或例子發展 main idea「主旨」。

subject: english
q: With only ten dollars, I cannot ____ the eighty-dollar ticket.
explain: afford 是「負擔得起」；手上金額不足以支付票價。reserve 是「預訂」，不表示有足夠金錢。

subject: english
q: The store returned the full price of my defective jacket; this repayment was a ____.
explain: refund 是「退款」，店家把已付的錢退回；discount 是「折扣」，指降低售價。

subject: english
q: Members pay less than the listed price because they receive a ten-percent ____.
explain: discount 是「折扣」，使實付金額低於標價；profit 是「利潤」，salary 是「薪資」。

subject: english
q: Although she earns more, Mia limits her travel ____ to the amount she sets aside for trips.
explain: budget 是「預算」，指預先安排可支出的金額；income 是「收入」，收入多不表示旅費預算也多。

subject: english
q: The hotel requires a ____ before arrival; the remaining payment is due at checkout.
explain: deposit 在此是「訂金」，先支付一部分，退房再付餘款；loan 是「貸款」，fine 是「罰款」。

subject: english
q: The driver told us the bus ____ was thirty dollars per passenger.
explain: fare 是「交通票價」，此處是每位乘客的公車車資；rent 是「租金」，salary 是「薪資」。

subject: english
q: The workers receive a basic hourly ____ of sixteen dollars, plus a separate bonus.
explain: wage 是「工資」，hourly wage 是「時薪」；bonus 是「獎金」，不是每小時固定的報酬。

subject: english
q: We ____ this apartment from its owner and pay monthly; we have not bought it.
explain: rent 是「租用」，按月付錢使用別人的公寓；purchase 是「購買」，inherit 是「繼承」。

subject: english
q: I was not hired to find the wallet, but its owner offered me a ____ as thanks.
explain: reward 是「獎賞、酬謝」；找回皮夾後獲得謝禮，並非受雇工作的 wage「工資」或 pension「退休金」。

subject: english
q: Sales covered every cost and left extra money; that extra money was the shop's ____.
explain: profit 是「利潤」，指收入扣除全部成本後的盈餘；expense 是「支出、費用」，不是賺得的錢。

subject: english
q: A broken signal caused a ____; our train left an hour later than planned.
explain: delay 是「延誤」，火車比原定時間晚開；transfer 是「轉乘」，departure 是「出發」。

subject: english
q: With the main road blocked, the driver studied the map and selected another ____ to the village.
explain: route 是「路線」，道路受阻時須另找能到村莊的路；distance 是「距離」，不代表行經哪條路。

subject: english
q: A bicycle is a two-wheeled ____ that carries a rider from place to place.
explain: vehicle 是「交通工具」；腳踏車可載人移動。engine 是「引擎」，container 是「容器」。

subject: english
q: At the airport, travelers waited beside the belt for their ____ to arrive.
explain: luggage 是「行李」，旅客在機場輸送帶旁等待領取；passport 是「護照」，不是一般托運物品。

subject: english
q: Flour is the main ____ in this bread; the recipe uses more of it than anything else.
explain: ingredient 是「食材、原料」，麵粉是製作麵包的主要成分；product 是「成品」，flavor 是「味道」。

subject: english
q: The lemon gives the soup a sour ____ that the other ingredients do not provide.
explain: flavor 是「味道」，sour 是「酸的」，屬於味覺線索；texture 是「口感、質地」，temperature 是「溫度」。

subject: english
q: Even the smell of dinner failed to increase his ____; he still wanted nothing to eat.
explain: appetite 是「食慾」，仍不想吃東西表示沒有胃口；mood 是「心情」，weight 是「體重」。

subject: english
q: The restaurant serves a smaller ____ for children, with half as much rice.
explain: portion 是「一份食物的分量」，米飯減半是在調整供餐分量；diet 是「飲食」，recipe 是「食譜」。

subject: english
q: The cut became swollen after bacteria entered it, causing an ____.
explain: infection 是「感染」，細菌進入傷口後引起腫脹；injury 是「受傷」，allergy 是「過敏」。

subject: english
q: Leo's broken wrist is an ____ from his fall, rather than a disease.
explain: injury 是「外傷、傷害」，跌倒造成手腕骨折屬於外傷；illness 是「疾病」，symptom 是「症狀」。

subject: english
q: This small electronic ____ records how far I walk each day.
explain: device 是「裝置」，這裡是記錄步行距離的電子設備；facility 是「設施」，material 是「材料」。

subject: english
q: The generator needs ____ such as gasoline to keep its engine running.
explain: fuel 是「燃料」，gasoline「汽油」可供引擎運轉；smoke 是「煙」，不是汽油所屬的物質類別。

subject: english
q: Cotton is the main ____ used to make this shirt, rather than wool or silk.
explain: material 是「材料、布料」，cotton「棉」是襯衫的製作材料；pattern 是「圖樣」，brand 是「品牌」。

subject: english
q: Instead of throwing away the used bottles, the factory will ____ them into new glass products.
explain: recycle 是「回收再利用」，把舊瓶加工成新玻璃製品；repair 是「修理」，並非重新製成新產品。

subject: english
q: The factory's untreated waste caused river ____, making the water unsafe for fish.
explain: pollution 是「污染」，未處理的廢棄物使河水不利魚類生存；erosion 是「侵蝕」，shortage 是「短缺」。

subject: english
q: Unlike today's weather, a region's ____ describes its usual conditions over many years.
explain: climate 是「氣候」，指長期的典型天氣狀況；forecast 是「預報」，temperature「溫度」只是其中一項要素。

subject: english
q: Tigers and lions belong to different ____, although both are large cats.
explain: species 是「物種」，老虎與獅子屬於不同物種；stage 是「階段」，crop 是「農作物」。

subject: english
q: The farmer planted rice as his main ____ and planned to sell it after harvest.
explain: crop 是「農作物」，稻米是農民種植並出售的作物；soil 是「土壤」，meadow 是「草地」。

subject: english
q: The apples are ripe, so workers will ____ them before they fall and spoil.
explain: harvest 是「採收、收割」；水果成熟後應採收，以免掉落腐壞。plant 是「種植」，scatter 是「撒開」。

subject: english
q: After the river overflowed, a ____ covered the nearby streets with water.
explain: flood 是「洪水」，河流溢出而淹沒街道；shower 是「陣雨」，frost 是「霜」。

subject: english
q: We moved out of direct sunlight and rested in the ____ of a large tree.
explain: shade 是「陰涼處」，樹木擋住陽光可供休息；glare 是「刺眼的光」，warmth 是「溫暖」。

subject: english
q: When heavy rain began, the hikers found ____ inside an empty cabin.
explain: shelter 是「遮蔽、避難處」，山屋可供登山客避雨；exposure 是「暴露」，scenery 是「景色」。

subject: english
q: The footprints were ____ that someone had entered the locked room.
explain: evidence 是「證據」，腳印支持有人進入房間的判斷；theory 是「理論」，prediction 是「預測」。

subject: english
q: Nina deliberately changed only the light during her ____ to test how it affected plant growth.
explain: experiment 是「實驗」，主動改變光照來檢驗影響；survey 是「調查」，debate 是「辯論」，不表示控制條件測試。

subject: english
q: The scientist proposed a ____ as a possible explanation of the results, but further tests were needed.
explain: theory 是「理論」，用來解釋結果並可接受檢驗；fact 是「事實」，survey 是「調查」。

subject: english
q: The report's final ____ states what the researchers learned from all their findings.
explain: conclusion 是「結論」，根據研究發現歸納所得；introduction 是「引言」，procedure 是「步驟」。

subject: english
q: Entries arriving after the ____ will be rejected, even if they are excellent.
explain: deadline 是「截止時間」，逾時的參賽作品不受理；interval 是「間隔」，opening 是「開始」。

subject: english
q: Our ____ lists the times of every lesson and break during the day.
explain: schedule 是「時間表」，列出各節課與休息時間；attendance 是「出席」，assignment 是「作業」。

subject: english
q: A formal statement that expresses dissatisfaction with poor service is a ____.
explain: complaint 是「抱怨、申訴」，用來表達對食物與服務的不滿；compliment 是「讚美」，apology 是「道歉」。

subject: english
q: One group wanted silence while another wanted music, creating a ____ over how to use the room.
explain: conflict 是「衝突」，兩組對房間用途有不相容的要求；contrast 是「對比」，contract 是「契約」。

subject: english
q: Given equal prices, I ____ the smaller bag because it is easier to carry.
explain: prefer 是「比較喜歡、偏好」，因較好攜帶而選小包；reject 是「拒絕」，與後面的理由不符。

subject: english
q: The new barrier is designed to ____ accidents by keeping cars from reaching the cliff.
explain: prevent 是「預防、阻止」，設置護欄是要避免事故發生；investigate 是「調查」，不是事前防範。

subject: english
q: Ben heard his phone ringing but chose to ____ it and continue reading without answering.
explain: ignore 是「不理會、忽視」，聽見鈴聲卻繼續閱讀而不接；misplace 是「放錯地方」，不是刻意不回應。

subject: english
q: To express that she wished she had acted differently, Mia said, 'I ____ my decision.'
explain: regret 是「後悔」，表示希望當初做出不同選擇；defend 是「為……辯護」，announce 是「宣布」。

subject: english
q: 'Rural' fits: 'We left the noisy city for a quiet ____ village among farms.'
explain: rural 是「鄉村的」，周圍是農田的村莊符合語境；urban 才是「都市的」。

subject: english
q: 'Domestic' fits: 'This ____ flight crosses the ocean from Taiwan to Canada.'
explain: domestic 是「國內的」；臺灣飛往加拿大屬於跨國航班，應用 international「國際的」。

subject: english
q: 'Anxious' fits: 'Worried about tomorrow's interview, Sue felt ____ and could not sleep.'
explain: anxious 在此是「焦慮的、擔心的」，呼應 worried 及因面試而失眠的語境。

subject: english
q: 'Curious' fits: 'Showing no interest at all, the child was ____ about the answer.'
explain: curious 是「好奇的」，與完全沒有興趣矛盾；此處可用 indifferent「漠不關心的」。

subject: english
q: 'Patient' fits: 'Unable to tolerate even a short wait, the customer became ____.'
explain: patient 是「有耐心的」；連短暫等待都無法忍受，應用 impatient「不耐煩的」。

subject: english
q: 'Familiar' fits: 'I have heard that song many times, so its melody sounds ____.'
explain: familiar 是「熟悉的」，聽過很多次的旋律會讓人感到熟悉；strange 是「陌生的」。

subject: english
q: 'Artificial' fits: 'These flowers grew naturally in the wild; they are ____.'
explain: artificial 是「人造的」，不是野外自然生長的；此處應用 natural「天然的」。

subject: english
q: 'Severe' fits: 'The storm caused enormous damage, so its effects were ____.'
explain: severe 是「嚴重的」，enormous damage「巨大損害」支持此用法；mild 是「輕微的」。

subject: english
q: 'Gradual' fits: 'The temperature rose suddenly in seconds, so the change was ____.'
explain: gradual 是「逐漸的」，與 suddenly「突然地」相反；此處可用 abrupt「突然的」。

subject: english
q: 'Annual' fits: 'The town holds this festival once every year; it is an ____ event.'
explain: annual 是「每年的、年度的」，once every year 就是每年一次；monthly 是「每月的」。

subject: english
q: 'Stubborn' fits: 'Mia always willingly changes her views, so she is too ____ to change her mind.'
explain: stubborn 是「固執的」；願意改變看法，與固執到不肯改變想法的描述矛盾。

subject: english
q: 'Visible' fits: 'The ink appears only under a special lamp; in ordinary light, it is ____.'
explain: visible 是「看得見的」；只有特殊燈下才顯現，普通光線下應是 invisible「看不見的」。

subject: english
q: 'Reasonable' fits: 'The two sides accepted the price as fair, calling it ____.'
explain: reasonable 是「合理的」，雙方認為價格公平，符合語境；不等於價格必然最低。

subject: english
q: 'Capable' fits: 'He wants to fix the engine but lacks every required skill; he is ____ of repairing it.'
explain: capable 是「有能力的」；有意願卻缺乏所需技能，不能說有能力修好，引擎維修能力與意願不同。

subject: english
q: 'Loyal' fits: 'Even when offered money to betray the team, she remained ____ to it.'
explain: loyal 是「忠誠的」；面對金錢利誘仍不背叛團隊，符合語境，betray 是「背叛」。

subject: english
q: 'Urgent' fits: 'The repair cannot wait because lives are at risk; it is ____.'
explain: urgent 是「緊急的、迫切的」；危及生命而不能延後處理，符合語境。

subject: english
q: The donor wanted to remain ____, so the charity published no name with the gift.
explain: anonymous 是「匿名的」，捐款紀錄未公開姓名；imaginary 是「虛構的」，不表示未具名。

subject: english
q: Please keep your bag out of the ____ so passengers can walk between the rows of seats.
explain: aisle 是「座位排之間的走道」；cabin 是「客艙」，platform 是「月臺」，都不是此處的通道。

subject: english
q: We changed trains twice, but our final ____ was still Tainan, where the journey ended.
explain: destination 是「目的地」，即旅程終點；departure 是「出發」，entrance 是「入口」。

subject: english
q: The doctor recorded the patient's cough as a ____ rather than the cause of the illness.
explain: symptom 是「症狀」，咳嗽是疾病可能呈現的表現，並非病因；cure 是「治療方法、治癒」。

subject: english
q: She studies ____, focusing on how food supplies the body with the substances it needs.
explain: nutrition 是「營養、營養學」，探討食物如何提供身體所需物質；appetite 是「食慾」，medication 是「藥物」。

subject: english
q: The wetland is the bird's natural ____; it provides the food and nesting sites the bird needs.
explain: habitat 是「棲地」，能提供生物所需的食物與繁殖場所；migration 是「遷徙」，diet 是「飲食」。

subject: english
q: Months without rain led to a severe ____, leaving wells empty and fields dry.
explain: drought 是「乾旱」，長期缺雨導致井水乾涸、田地乾燥；erosion 是「侵蝕」，storm 是「暴風雨」。

subject: english
q: She studies ____, learning how buildings are designed rather than how machines are built.
explain: architecture 是「建築學」，研究建築設計；psychology 是「心理學」，agriculture 是「農業」，economics 是「經濟學」。

subject: english
q: A refrigerator is a household ____ used to keep food cold.
explain: appliance 是「家用電器」，冰箱即為一例；furniture 是「家具」，fabric 是「布料」，decoration 是「裝飾品」。

subject: english
q: When Eva praised his clear explanation, he thanked her for the ____.
explain: compliment 是「讚美」，呼應 praised「稱讚」；insult 是「侮辱」，complaint 是「抱怨」，warning 是「警告」。

subject: english
q: The center serves ____ visitors between thirteen and eighteen, rather than young children or elderly adults.
explain: adolescent 是「青少年的」，符合十三至十八歲的語境；infant 是「嬰兒的」，middle-aged 是「中年的」。

subject: english
q: Before the meeting, the chair sent an ____ listing the issues we would discuss.
explain: agenda 是「議程」，列出會議預定討論事項；timetable 是「時間表」，budget 是「預算」，allowance 是「津貼」。

subject: english
q: Her ability to explain complex ideas clearly is an ____ to the team, helping everyone work together.
explain: asset 在此是「有助益的人事物、優勢」，清楚說明的能力有利團隊；liability 是「負擔、累贅」。

subject: english
q: The company offers a bonus as an ____ to encourage workers to suggest useful improvements.
explain: incentive 是「誘因」，獎金用來促使員工提出改善建議；obligation 是「義務」，obstacle 是「障礙」。

subject: english
q: The writer died long ago, but her books remain an influential ____ passed down to later generations.
explain: legacy 是「留下的影響、傳承」，作品持續影響後代；novelty 是「新奇事物」，prospect 是「前景」。

subject: english
q: The branch gained ____ to make its own decisions without seeking permission from headquarters.
explain: autonomy 是「自主權」，分部可自行決策而不必請示；supervision 是「監督」，dependence 是「依賴」。

subject: english
q: The cyclist began to ____, moving faster each second as the finish line approached.
explain: accelerate 是「加速」，速度逐秒增加；brake 是「煞車」，pause 是「暫停」，hesitate 是「猶豫」。

subject: english
q: The advertisement increased sales and helped ____ the company's income.
explain: boost 是「提升、促進」，廣告帶動銷售並增加公司收入；reduce 是「減少」，consume 是「消耗」。

subject: english
q: The committee voted to ____ the existing rule by changing just one sentence.
explain: amend 是「修訂」，保留既有規則並修改部分內容；abolish 是「廢除」，enforce 是「執行」。

subject: english
q: The hall can ____ three hundred guests, but there is no room for more.
explain: accommodate 在此是「容納」，指會場能容納的人數；invite 是「邀請」，transport 是「運送」。

subject: english
q: The doctor used test results to ____ the illness, identifying which disease the patient had.
explain: diagnose 是「診斷」，判定病人罹患何種疾病；prescribe 是「開處方」，cure 是「治癒」，均不同於辨認病名。

subject: english
q: Because of thick fog, the airline had to ____ all flights until visibility improved.
explain: suspend 是「暫停」，濃霧使航班暫停至能見度改善；resume 是「恢復」，maintain 是「維持」。

subject: english
q: The council voted to ____ the outdated rule completely, so it would no longer exist.
explain: abolish 是「廢除」，使規則完全不再存在；amend 是「修訂」，enforce 是「執行」，retain 是「保留」。

subject: english
q: Bags that ____ the weight limit are heavier than allowed and require an extra payment.
explain: exceed 是「超過」，行李超重才加收費用；reach 是「達到」，恰好達到上限不等於超過。

subject: english
q: Keep chemicals away from the water supply so they do not ____ it and make it unsafe to drink.
explain: contaminate 是「汙染」，使供水不再能安全飲用；protect 是「保護」，filter 是「過濾」，store 是「儲存」。

subject: english
q: She will ____ the house from her grandmother after the grandmother dies, as stated in the will.
explain: inherit 是「繼承」，依遺囑承接祖母的房子；will 在此是「遺囑」，purchase 是「購買」。

subject: english
q: To ensure the teams work together smoothly, the manager will ____ their tasks and schedules.
explain: coordinate 是「協調」，使各團隊的工作及時程配合順利；disrupt 是「擾亂」，conceal 是「隱瞞」，neglect 是「忽略」。

subject: english
q: The advertiser tried to ____ customers by secretly using their fears to control their choices.
explain: manipulate 在此是「操控」，暗中利用恐懼左右消費者選擇；inform 是「告知」，protect 是「保護」。

subject: english
q: Please ____ all applicants by email when the interview date changes.
explain: notify 是「通知」，面試日期改變時應告知應徵者；nominate 是「提名」，accuse 是「指控」。

subject: english
q: The signs ____ smoking in this room; nobody is allowed to smoke here.
explain: prohibit 是「禁止」，呼應不准吸菸；permit 是「允許」，promote 是「促進、推廣」。

subject: english
q: The hospital hopes to ____ ten new nurses to fill its vacant positions.
explain: recruit 是「招募」，為空缺職位找新人；dismiss 是「解雇」，retire 是「退休、使退休」。

subject: english
q: The course will ____ music and history, teaching them together rather than as separate subjects.
explain: integrate 是「整合」，把音樂與歷史結合教授；separate 是「分開」，confuse 是「混淆」，exclude 是「排除」。

subject: english
q: Wind turbines ____ electricity by converting the energy of moving air.
explain: generate 是「產生」，風力發電機把風的能量轉成電能；store 是「儲存」，consume 是「消耗」，purchase 是「購買」。

subject: english
q: We have no butter, so we will ____ oil for it in this recipe.
explain: substitute 是「替代」，此處以油代替奶油；exclude 是「排除」，separate 是「分開」。

subject: english
q: The policy is ____; even exceptional cases receive no special treatment or adjustments.
explain: rigid 是「僵化的、無彈性的」，連特殊情況也不調整；flexible 是「有彈性的」，casual 是「隨意的」。

subject: english
q: The two colors differ only slightly; the difference is so ____ that most people miss it.
explain: subtle 是「細微而不易察覺的」，呼應多數人看不出差異；noticeable 是「明顯可察覺的」，sharp 在此是「明顯的」。

subject: english
q: This ____ system combines advanced technology with many carefully coordinated parts.
explain: sophisticated 在此是「精密複雜的」，結合先進技術與協調運作的零件；primitive 是「原始的」，crude 是「粗糙的」。

subject: english
q: Only residents may apply for the grant; because I live elsewhere, I am not ____.
explain: eligible 是「符合資格的」，非居民不符申請條件；willing 是「願意的」，有意願也不等於有資格。

subject: english
q: The bank confirmed that these two sums have exactly the same value; they are ____.
explain: equivalent 是「等值的」，兩筆金額價值完全相同；variable 是「會變動的」，excessive 是「過多的」。

subject: english
q: Which word means 'belonging to the present time'?
explain: contemporary 是「當代的、屬於現今的」；ancient 是「古代的」，antique 是「古老的、古董的」，classical 是「古典的」。

subject: english
q: Unlike a brief illness, a ____ condition continues for a long time.
explain: chronic 是「慢性的、長期的」，重點是持續時間；mild 是「輕微的」，描述嚴重程度而非時間長短。

subject: english
q: He trusted the stranger's impossible promise without question; his friends called him ____.
explain: naive 是「天真的、易輕信的」，不加懷疑便相信不可能的承諾；cautious 是「謹慎的」，suspicious 是「懷疑的」。

subject: english
q: Trying to avoid offending either side, the speaker used ____ language during the delicate talks.
explain: diplomatic 在此是「圓融得體的」，說話避免冒犯雙方；offensive 是「冒犯人的」，aggressive 是「咄咄逼人的」。

subject: english
q: During the dispute, the mediator remained ____, supporting neither side.
explain: neutral 是「中立的」，調解者不偏向任何一方；partial 在此是「偏袒的」，hostile 是「敵對的」。

subject: english
q: 'Adverse' fits: 'The new rule harmed small shops, so its effects on them were ____.'
explain: adverse 是「不利的、有害的」，呼應 harmed「造成傷害」；不是 advantageous「有利的」。

subject: english
q: 'Beneficial' fits: 'The policy harms students and offers them no advantages; it is ____ to them.'
explain: beneficial 是「有益的」；政策傷害學生且沒有任何好處，不能說對他們有益。

subject: english
q: 'Compatible' fits: 'The new battery works correctly with this camera; the two are ____.'
explain: compatible 是「相容的」，新電池可與相機正常搭配使用；不是只指外觀相似。

subject: english
q: 'Eloquent' fits: 'He could not express any idea clearly or fluently; his speech was ____.'
explain: eloquent 是「表達流暢、有說服力的」；完全無法清楚流暢表達的演說不符合此義。

subject: english
q: 'Excessive' fits: 'The rule allows a maximum of ten guests; bringing fifty is ____.'
explain: excessive 是「過量的、過度的」，帶來五十人超過十人的上限；不是 merely enough「僅僅足夠」。

subject: english
q: 'Minimal' fits: 'The repair required an enormous amount of work, so the effort was ____.'
explain: minimal 是「極少的、最低限度的」；enormous「龐大的」工作量，與所需心力極少的描述矛盾。

subject: english
q: 'Inherent' fits: 'The color comes from the stone itself, rather than paint; it is an ____ property.'
explain: inherent 是「內在固有的」，指石頭本身具有的特性，而不是後來塗上油漆造成的。

subject: english
q: 'Hostile' fits: 'She warmly welcomed the visitors and gladly helped them; she was ____ toward them.'
explain: hostile 是「有敵意的、不友善的」；熱情歡迎並樂意幫助訪客，與敵意的描述不符。

subject: english
q: 'Obscure' fits: 'Almost nobody has heard of the composer; she remains ____.'
explain: obscure 在此是「沒沒無聞的」，幾乎無人聽過這位作曲家；不是在說作品難以理解。

subject: english
q: 'Preliminary' fits: 'Before the main race, runners competed in a ____ round to qualify for the final.'
explain: preliminary 是「預備的、初步的」，preliminary round 指決賽前的預賽；不是說賽程尚未確定。

subject: english
q: 'Profound' fits: 'The book changed her basic beliefs about life; its influence was ____.'
explain: profound 是「深遠的、深刻的」，影響到基本人生信念；不是 superficial「表面的」。

subject: english
q: 'Toxic' fits: 'The label says this substance is harmless to humans; it is ____ to humans.'
explain: toxic 是「有毒的」；題幹明說對人體無害，不能同時以有毒來描述對人體的作用。

subject: english
q: 'Vague' fits: 'The directions give exact details and leave nothing unclear; they are ____.'
explain: vague 是「含糊的、不明確的」；指示詳細確切且沒有不清楚的地方，不符合此義。

subject: english
q: 'Valid' fits: 'The ticket expired yesterday, so it is still ____ for travel today.'
explain: valid 在此是「有效的」，已過使用期限的票不能說仍有效；expired 是「已到期的」。

subject: english
q: 'Verbal' fits: 'The attack used insulting words rather than physical force; it was ____ abuse.'
explain: verbal 是「語言的」，此處 verbal abuse 指「言語辱罵」，與 physical「肢體的」攻擊區別。

subject: english
q: 'Virtual' fits: 'We walked through the actual rooms without digital images; our tour was entirely ____.'
explain: virtual 在此是「虛擬的」，指透過數位方式模擬的參觀；實際走訪真實房間不符合此義。

subject: english
q: I said I would keep your secret, and I will not ____ that promise.
explain: break a promise 是「違背承諾」；keep a secret 是「保守祕密」，此處承諾不洩密。

subject: english
q: Calling a task a piece of cake means it is easy.
explain: a piece of cake 是「輕而易舉的事」；task 是「任務」，不是字面上的蛋糕。

subject: english
q: Backing up files means making extra copies that can be used if the originals are lost.
explain: back up 資料是「備份」；extra copies 是「額外副本」，originals 是「原始檔」。

subject: english
q: After the rejection, Nina needed time to ____ her disappointment and try again.
explain: get over 在此是「從失望中恢復、克服失落」；try again 表示走出失落後重新嘗試。

subject: english
q: To break the ice at a meeting is to make people feel more uncomfortable with one another.
explain: break the ice 是「打破僵局、緩和初見的尷尬」，使人更自在，並非更不舒服。

subject: english
q: Although he supports recycling, he objects ____ placing a noisy recycling station beside his home.
explain: object to 是「反對」，後接名詞或動名詞；支持回收仍可能反對特定設置位置。

subject: english
q: The small printer is capable ____ printing on both sides of a page.
explain: be capable of 是「有能力、能夠」，of 後接 printing「列印」。

subject: english
q: Saying that a person passed away is a gentle way of saying that the person died.
explain: pass away 是「過世」，屬於較委婉的死亡說法；gentle 在此是「溫和的」。

subject: english
q: Someone stole Mia's wallet; the thief robbed her ____ her cash and cards.
explain: rob 人 of 物是「搶走某人的某物」；steal 物 from 人才用 from，cash 是「現金」。

subject: english
q: Please book your seat in ____ because tickets often sell out early.
explain: in advance 是「事先、提前」；book a seat 是「訂位」，sell out 是「售完」。

subject: english
q: When the manager retires, her deputy will ____ the department.
explain: take over 是「接管、接任」；deputy 是「副手」，此處副手將接管部門。

subject: english
q: Dad will ____ my sister at the station and drive her home.
explain: pick up 在接送情境是「開車接人」；pick out 是「挑選」，pick on 是「找碴」。

subject: english
q: Mia and her roommate ____ each other and rarely argue.
explain: get along with 是「與……相處融洽」；rarely argue 表示「很少爭吵」。

subject: english
q: The brothers ____ each other over money and stopped speaking.
explain: fall out with 是「與……鬧翻」；stopped speaking 表示不再交談，fall back on 是「依靠」。

subject: english
q: After camping, we must ____ the tent before packing it into its bag.
explain: take down 在此是「拆下、拆除」；收進袋子前須先拆帳篷，take on 是「承擔」。

subject: english
q: The instructions were confusing, but we finally ____ how the lock worked.
explain: figure out 是「弄懂、想明白」；此處終於理解鎖如何運作，fill in 是「填寫」。

subject: english
q: This song reminds me ____ the summer I spent with my grandparents.
explain: remind A of B 是「使 A 想起 B」；此處歌曲勾起暑假回憶。

subject: english
q: I prefer cycling ____ driving because it keeps me active.
explain: prefer A to B 是「比起 B 更喜歡 A」；不要混用比較級的 than，cycling 是「騎自行車」。

subject: english
q: Please ____ these mixed buttons into groups by color.
explain: sort out 在此是「分類整理」；依顏色把混雜的鈕扣分組，stand for 是「代表」。

subject: english
q: We thanked the volunteers ____ cleaning the beach.
explain: thank 人 for 事是「為某事感謝某人」；volunteers 是「志工」。

subject: english
q: The repairs are ____; workers are fixing the roof right now.
explain: under way 是「正在進行」；工人此刻仍在修屋頂，排除 on hold「暫停中」。

subject: english
q: Are you familiar ____ the rules of this board game?
explain: be familiar with 是「熟悉」；此處問是否熟悉桌遊規則，rules 是「規則」。

subject: english
q: To let your teammates down is to help them achieve everything they expected.
explain: let someone down 是「使某人失望」；不是幫隊友達成所有期望，teammates 是「隊友」。

subject: english
q: Lena received an invitation ____ the award ceremony.
explain: an invitation to 是「參加……的邀請」；award ceremony 是「頒獎典禮」，invitation 是名詞「邀請」。

subject: english
q: If a flood wipes out a village, it leaves the village completely unharmed.
explain: wipe out 是「徹底摧毀、消滅」；unharmed 是「未受損害的」，意思相反。

subject: english
q: The art class made good ____ of empty boxes by turning them into models.
explain: make good use of 是「善用」；use 在此為名詞，指把空紙箱充分利用來製作模型。

subject: english
q: The old captain must ____ command to her replacement before leaving the ship.
explain: hand over command 是「移交指揮權」；replacement 是「接任者」，hand out 是「分發」。

subject: english
q: Please drop me ____ at the library entrance; you can keep driving afterward.
explain: drop someone off 是「讓某人下車、順路送達」；受詞 me 是代名詞，放在 drop 與 off 之間。

subject: english
q: Do not ____ a conclusion until you have checked all the evidence.
explain: draw a conclusion 是「下結論」；evidence 是「證據」，應查驗後再下結論。

subject: english
q: The suspect was arrested for ____ a crime.
explain: commit a crime 是「犯罪」；occur、happen、arise 表「發生」時不能直接接 a crime 當受詞。

subject: english
q: Demand ____ warm coats rises when cold weather arrives.
explain: demand for 是「對……的需求」；warm coats 是「保暖外套」，名詞 demand 後用 for。

subject: english
q: The sign says 'Do not feed the monkeys.' It warns visitors ____ feeding them.
explain: warn someone against V-ing 是「警告某人不要做某事」；告示明確禁止餵食猴子。

subject: english
q: Leaving a detail out of a summary means including that detail in the summary.
explain: leave out 是「省略、遺漏」；including 是「包含」，summary 是「摘要」。

subject: english
q: Your explanation does not ____ sense; these two statements contradict each other.
explain: make sense 是「有道理、說得通」；contradict 是「互相矛盾」，此處解釋不合理。

subject: english
q: Ben has a sore throat and fever; he may be ____ the flu.
explain: come down with 是「開始罹患」疾病；sore throat 是「喉嚨痛」，fever 是「發燒」。

subject: english
q: Which phrase means 'without success'? Rescuers searched ____ but found no trace of the boat.
explain: in vain 是「徒勞地、沒有成功地」；in person 是「親自」，in turn 是「依序、輪流」。

subject: english
q: Her first teacher had a lasting influence ____ her career choice.
explain: an influence on 是「對……的影響」；lasting 是「持久的」，career choice 是「職業選擇」。

subject: english
q: A fire ____ in the kitchen while everyone was outside.
explain: break out 指火災、戰爭等「突然發生」；break in 是「闖入」。

subject: english
q: The copy looked genuine, so Jo ____ it for the original until an expert corrected her.
explain: mistake A for B 是「把 A 誤認為 B」；genuine 是「真的」，original 是「原作」。

subject: english
q: Please do not ____ salary during dinner; we can discuss it at tomorrow's meeting.
explain: bring up 話題是「提出、提起」；salary 是「薪資」，bring along 是「帶來」。

subject: english
q: The seller took advantage ____ my lack of experience and charged me twice the normal price.
explain: take advantage of 在此是「利用……占便宜」；lack of experience 是「缺乏經驗」，賣家因此超收費用。

subject: english
q: If a jacket costs an arm and a leg, it is very cheap.
explain: cost an arm and a leg 是「非常昂貴」；cheap 是「便宜的」，與此慣用語意思相反。

subject: english
q: Ask Eva about the budget; she is in charge ____ the event.
explain: in charge of 是「掌管、負責」；budget 是「預算」，此處 Eva 是活動負責人。

subject: english
q: The campaign aims to ____ awareness of food waste among students.
explain: raise awareness 是「提升意識」；raise 是及物動詞，rise「上升」不能直接接 awareness。

subject: english
q: When a noisy class settles down, it becomes calmer.
explain: settle down 在此是「安靜下來、平靜下來」；calmer 是「更平靜的」。

subject: english
q: The island has no bridge; supplies arrive by ____ of small boats.
explain: by means of 是「藉由、透過」；此處用小船運補，supplies 是「補給品」。

subject: english
q: Finishing a task at the eleventh hour means finishing it long before the deadline.
explain: at the eleventh hour 是「在最後一刻」；不是距離截止期限還很久，deadline 是「截止期限」。

subject: english
q: The bags cost the same, but in ____ of weight, the blue one is better for hiking.
explain: in terms of 是「就……而言」；價格相同時，這裡改就重量評比，weight 是「重量」。

subject: english
q: Being in two minds about accepting a job means being completely certain that you want it.
explain: in two minds 是「猶豫不決」；不是完全確定要接受工作，certain 是「確定的」。

subject: english
q: Which verb completes the phrase meaning 'finish on time'? We must ____ the deadline.
explain: meet a deadline 是「如期完成、趕上截止期限」；face a deadline 只是「面對期限」，不表示如期完成。

subject: english
q: I apologized ____ the librarian for returning the book late.
explain: apologize to 人 for 事是「為某事向某人道歉」；librarian 是「圖書館員」。

subject: english
q: The shelter provides homeless people ____ warm meals.
explain: provide 人 with 物是「提供某人某物」；shelter 是「收容所」，warm meals 是「熱食」。

subject: english
q: A person who speaks her mind expresses what she honestly thinks.
explain: speak one's mind 是「坦率說出想法」；honestly 是「誠實地、坦白地」。

subject: english
q: Which phrase means 'caused to happen'? The talks ____ changes to school rules.
explain: bring about 是「導致、促成」；bring up 是「提起」，bring back 是「恢復、帶回」，都不等於題幹指定的致因義。

subject: english
q: An editor can point out an error without correcting it.
explain: point out 是「指出」；指出錯誤只表示讓人注意到，不代表已經改正，correct 是「改正」。

subject: english
q: If Mira gets cold feet before her first stage performance, she becomes nervous about going through with it.
explain: get cold feet 是「臨陣膽怯」；going through with it 是「把原定的事做到底」。

subject: english
q: Feeling under the weather means feeling slightly ill.
explain: under the weather 是「身體不適」；slightly ill 是「有點不舒服」。

subject: english
q: The firefighters quickly ____ the flames before they reached the next house.
explain: put out 是「撲滅」，可搭配 flames「火焰」；put aside 是「放一旁」。

subject: english
q: Someone on the fence about an issue has not yet chosen which side to support.
explain: on the fence 是「尚未表態、猶豫未決」；issue 是「議題」，side 是「立場」。

subject: english
q: The captain accepted the prize on ____ of the whole team, not just for herself.
explain: on behalf of 是「代表」；隊長代表全隊領獎，prize 是「獎品、獎項」。

subject: english
q: Construction has stopped until the safety review is finished; the project is now ____.
explain: on hold 是「暫停中」；施工已停止，須等安全審查完成才繼續，並非 under way「正在進行」。

subject: english
q: The schedule should ____ a balance between study and rest, allowing enough time for both.
explain: strike a balance 是「取得平衡」；此處指兼顧讀書與休息，break「打破」不符合兩者都有足夠時間的語意。

subject: english
q: Throwing plastic into the sea can ____ harm to marine animals.
explain: do harm to 是「對……造成傷害」；marine animals 是「海洋動物」。

subject: english
q: If Leo takes up painting, the phrase itself means he becomes a professional painter.
explain: take up painting 只表示「開始從事繪畫」，不代表成為專業畫家；professional 是「專業的」。

subject: english
q: The twins look alike, but their interests differ ____ each other.
explain: differ from 是「與……不同」；look alike 是「看起來相像」，此處比較兩人的興趣。

subject: english
q: If you visit a town once in a blue moon, you visit it very rarely.
explain: once in a blue moon 是「極少、難得一次」；rarely 是「很少地」。

subject: english
q: The neighbors ____ a reading club so local children could share books.
explain: set up 意為「成立、建立」，符合成立讀書會的情境；set aside 是「留出」。

subject: english
q: Engineers are seeking a solution ____ the water shortage.
explain: a solution to 是「……的解決辦法」；water shortage 是「缺水」，名詞 solution 搭配 to。

subject: english
q: The coach insists ____ checking our equipment before every climb.
explain: insist on 是「堅持」，on 後可接動名詞；equipment 是「裝備」，checking 是「檢查」。

subject: english
q: A student under pressure has no demands or expectations to worry about.
explain: under pressure 是「承受壓力」；demands 是「要求」，expectations 是「期望」。

subject: english
q: We waited for Rita at the cafe, but she never ____.
explain: turn up 在此是「出現、到場」；never 表示她一直沒有到，turn over 是「翻轉」。

subject: english
q: The factory receives cotton from farms and supplies finished cloth ____ local shops.
explain: supply 物 to 人或機構是「供應某物給……」；商店是布料的接收方，from 表示來源。

subject: english
q: Leo keeps mentioning his expensive watch because he wants to ____.
explain: show off 是「炫耀」；反覆提昂貴手錶是在炫耀，show around 是「帶領參觀」。

subject: english
q: Her grandparents brought her up from birth. Here, brought her up means mentioned her in a conversation.
explain: bring someone up from birth 是「從出生起養育某人」；在此語境中不是談話時「提起某人」。

subject: english
q: Which adjective describes a hardworking person, rather than something related to industry?
explain: industrious 是「勤奮的」；industrial 是「工業的」，兩字雖同源，意思不同。

subject: english
q: The designer is highly ____ and often invents unusual solutions.
explain: creative 是「有創意的」；-ive 可形成形容詞，此處描述設計師的特質。

subject: english
q: In "Please water the plants," water is a verb meaning ____.
