explain: water 作名詞是「水」，此處轉作動詞「澆水」；不是把植物完全淹沒或排掉水。

subject: english
q: A counterattack is an attack made before the opponent has attacked.
explain: counterattack 是「反擊」；counter- 在此表示對抗、回應，須已有對方的攻擊。

subject: english
q: Which adjective is formed by adding a suffix to 'nature'?
explain: nature「自然」加 -al 形成形容詞 natural「自然的」；naturally 是副詞，naturalness 是名詞。

subject: english
q: If two writers coauthor a book, they write it ____.
explain: coauthor 是「合著」；co- 表示「共同」，兩位作者一起寫書。

subject: english
q: In "microphone," the root phon refers to ____.
explain: phon 字根表示「聲音」；microphone 是「麥克風」，與聲音相關。

subject: english
q: The prefix semi- makes a semicircle ____ of a circle.
explain: semi- 表示「一半」；semicircle 是「半圓」，circle 是「圓」。

subject: english
q: Although she trains new staff, Sara is still an ____ paid by the company.
explain: employee 是「受雇者」；即使負責訓練新人，受公司付薪雇用的身分仍是員工。

subject: english
q: The root geo- in "geography" refers to ____.
explain: geo- 表示「地球、大地」；geography 是「地理學」。

subject: english
q: The shared root vis in "visible" and "vision" relates to ____.
explain: vis 字根表示「看」；visible 是「看得見的」，vision 是「視覺」。

subject: english
q: The shared root ject in "inject" and "reject" originally relates to ____.
explain: ject 字根表示「投擲」；inject「注射」有投入之意，reject「拒絕」有拋回之意。

subject: english
q: In 'They purchased new bikes,' purchased is a noun.
explain: purchased 在此是動詞 purchase「購買」的過去式；本句的名詞 bikes 才是「自行車」。

subject: english
q: The root spect in "inspect" is connected with ____.
explain: spect 字根表示「看」；inspect 是「檢查」，含有仔細觀看的概念。

subject: english
q: The adverb formed from 'automatic' is spelled 'automaticly'.
explain: automatic「自動的」對應的副詞是 automatically「自動地」；正確字尾是 -ically，不是 -icly。

subject: english
q: Which form correctly completes 'a twelve-____ student'?
explain: twelve-year-old 是「十二歲的」；此類放在名詞前的複合形容詞中，表示年齡單位的 year 用單數。

subject: english
q: His childish behavior annoyed everyone; "childish" here means ____.
explain: childish 在此是貶義的「幼稚的」；childlike 多指「天真如孩童的」，較無貶意。

subject: english
q: The effects were mainly ____, including damage to soil and water.
explain: environmental 是形容詞「環境的」，描述 effects「影響」的性質；environmentalism 是名詞「環保主義」。

subject: english
q: In 'pianist,' the suffix -ist helps name a person who ____.
explain: pianist 是「鋼琴演奏者」，由 piano 去掉字尾 o 後加 -ist 形成；-ist 可表示從事某項活動的人。

subject: english
q: The prefix micro- in "microscope" suggests that the objects being viewed are ____.
explain: micro- 表示「微小」；microscope 是「顯微鏡」，用來觀察微小物體。

subject: english
q: The prisoners longed for ____ and hoped to leave the jail.
explain: freedom 是名詞「自由」；-dom 可表示狀態，prisoners 是「囚犯」。

subject: english
q: Which adjective means "useful in real situations"?
explain: practical 是「實用的」；practice 是「練習」，practically 是副詞，practiced 多指「熟練的」。

subject: english
q: Choose the pair that completes both blanks: "a strong ____" and "I ____ you."
explain: a strong 後需名詞 belief「信念」；I 後需動詞 believe「相信」，believable 是「可信的」。

subject: english
q: Both "a living plant" and "the plant is alive" can describe a plant that is not dead.
explain: living「活著的」可放名詞前；alive「活著的」可接在連綴動詞 is 後，兩種句型都正確。

subject: english
q: Which adjective specifically means "important in history," rather than simply "related to the past"?
explain: historic 是「具有歷史意義的」；historical 是「與歷史相關的」，兩者強調的意思不同。

subject: english
q: The root aud in "audible" and "audience" relates to ____.
explain: aud 字根表示「聽」；audible 是「聽得見的」，audience 是「聽眾、觀眾」。

subject: english
q: In "manuscript," the root script relates to ____.
explain: script 字根表示「書寫」；manuscript 是「手稿」，不是與聽覺或加熱相關。

subject: english
q: In "The team suffered a loss," loss is a noun related to the verb lose.
explain: loss 是名詞「損失、敗北」，lose 是動詞「失去、輸掉」；此處用名詞表示一次敗北。

subject: english
q: A transatlantic journey goes ____ the Atlantic Ocean.
explain: trans- 在此表示「橫越」；transatlantic 是「橫越大西洋的」，journey 是「旅程」。

subject: english
q: Good ____ means being present regularly, not merely arriving early once.
explain: attendance 是「出席」；-ance 可形成名詞，attentive 是「專心的」，不是出席情況。

subject: english
q: The ending -free in "sugar-free" means full of sugar.
explain: sugar-free 是「不含糖的」；-free 在此表示「不含……的」，不是充滿糖。

subject: english
q: A sleepy child must already be asleep.
explain: sleepy 是「想睡的」，asleep 是「睡著的」；覺得睏不代表已進入睡眠。

subject: english
q: In "They traveled homeward," -ward indicates movement toward home.
explain: -ward 表示「朝……方向」；homeward 是「朝家的方向」，traveled 是「行進、旅行」。

subject: english
q: Chronological order arranges events by place rather than time.
explain: chron 字根表示「時間」；chronological order 是「時間先後順序」，不是按地點排列。

subject: english
q: Adding -al to 'arrive' requires dropping the final e to form 'arrival'.
explain: arrive「抵達」去掉字尾不發音的 e，再加 -al，成為名詞 arrival「抵達」。

subject: english
q: The children gave a ____ shout when their missing dog returned.
explain: 修飾 shout「喊聲」用形容詞 joyful「喜悅的」；-ful 可形成形容詞，joy 是「喜悅」。

subject: english
q: Can you ____ these instructions so younger children can understand them?
explain: simplify 是動詞「簡化」；-ify 可形成動詞，simplicity 是名詞「簡單」。

subject: english
q: A bilingual dictionary gives information in ____ languages.
explain: bi- 表示「二、雙」；bilingual 是「雙語的」，dictionary 是「字典」。

subject: english
q: To defrost a freezer is to ____ the frost inside it.
explain: defrost 是「除霜」；de- 在此表示去除，frost 是「霜」，freezer 是「冷凍櫃」。

subject: english
q: The root struct in "construction" relates to building.
explain: struct 字根表示「建造」；construction 是「建造、建築工程」。

subject: english
q: The prefix multi- in 'multicultural' means ____.
explain: multi- 表示「多」；multicultural 是「多元文化的」，between「在……之間」則是 inter- 的常見意思。

subject: english
q: A nonverbal message is communicated ____ words.
explain: nonverbal 是「非口語的、不使用言語的」；non- 表示「非」，如用手勢傳達。

subject: english
q: Which word correctly means "not legal"?
explain: legal「合法的」的否定形是 illegal「非法的」；此字在 l 前使用 il-。

subject: english
q: The hike was exhausting even for trained athletes; "exhausting" means it ____.
explain: exhausting 是「令人筋疲力盡的」，描述造成疲累的事物；exhausted 才是「感到筋疲力盡的」。

subject: english
q: The orchestra invited a ____ to perform a violin solo.
explain: musician 是「音樂家」，由 music 加 -ian 形成表示人的名詞；musical 是形容詞「音樂的」。

subject: english
q: In "submarine," the prefix sub- suggests a position ____ the sea surface.
explain: sub- 表示「在……之下」；submarine 是「潛水艇」，sea surface 是「海面」。

subject: english
q: In "dictation," the root dict is related to ____.
explain: dict 字根表示「說」；dictation 是「聽寫」，由一人說出內容讓別人寫下。

subject: english
q: Which pair keeps the same spelling when a noun becomes a verb?
explain: record「紀錄／記錄」名動詞拼字相同；choice / choose「選擇」等詞對的拼字則會改變。

subject: english
q: Compost can ____ poor soil by adding nutrients.
explain: enrich 是「使豐富、使肥沃」；en- 在 rich「豐富的」前形成動詞，nutrients 是「養分」。

subject: english
q: In "thermometer," therm relates to heat.
explain: therm 字根表示「熱」；thermometer 是「溫度計」，用來測量溫度。

subject: english
q: Which shortened noun means 'an advertisement'?
explain: ad「廣告」是 advertisement「廣告」的縮略形式；advertise 是動詞「登廣告」，advertiser 是「廣告主」。

subject: english
q: A waterproof material is designed to prevent water from passing through it.
explain: waterproof 是「防水的」；-proof 表示「防……的」，material 是「材料」。

subject: english
q: Which phrase is correct in standard written English?
explain: information「資訊」是不可數名詞，不能加 -s 或直接接 an；一則資訊可說 a piece of information。

subject: english
q: Unlike a biography written by someone else, an autobiography is written by ____.
explain: auto- 表示「自己」；autobiography 是「自傳」，由傳主自己撰寫，biography 是「傳記」。

subject: english
q: If cyclists outnumber drivers, there are more cyclists than drivers.
explain: outnumber 是「數量超過」；out- 在此表示超越，cyclists 是「自行車騎士」。

subject: english
q: Greenish means completely lacking any green color.
explain: greenish 是「略帶綠色的」；-ish 在此表示「稍微、略帶」，不是完全沒有綠色。

subject: english
q: Which noun names the relationship between friends?
explain: friendship 是「友誼」，表示朋友間的關係；friendliness 是「友善的態度」，不是關係名稱。

subject: english
q: 'Convenience' is a noun, while 'convenient' is an adjective.
explain: convenience「便利」是名詞；convenient「方便的」是對應形容詞，可用來修飾地點或服務。

subject: english
q: The root tract in "attract" is connected with pushing things away.
explain: tract 字根表示「拉」；attract 是「吸引」，有拉近之意，不是往外推。

subject: english
q: The bottle is ____ empty, but a little water remains.
explain: nearly 是「幾乎」，可修飾 empty「空的」；nearby 是「在附近」，nearness 是名詞「接近」。

subject: english
q: In 'Pressing this button will activate the alarm,' activate is a noun.
explain: activate 是動詞「啟動」，對應形容詞 active「活躍的」；此處 will 後接原形動詞，不是名詞。

subject: english
q: In "They must proof their claim with evidence," proof is the standard verb meaning demonstrate.
explain: 表示「證明主張」應用動詞 prove；proof 通常是名詞「證據」，此處不能代替 must 後的原形動詞 prove。

subject: english
q: The root graph in "autograph" relates to ____.
explain: graph 字根表示「書寫、記錄」；autograph 是「親筆簽名」，不是與聲音或光線相關。

subject: english
q: The lake's ____ was measured in meters.
explain: depth「深度」是形容詞 deep「深的」對應的名詞；此處作主詞，deeply 是副詞，deepen 是動詞「加深」。

subject: english
q: Which adjective means "existing only in the mind," rather than "good at creating new ideas"?
explain: imaginary 是「想像的、虛構的」；imaginative 是「富有想像力的」，描述擅長創造想法的人。

subject: english
q: Which adjective means 'showing respect,' rather than 'worthy of respect'?
explain: respectful 是「表示尊重的」；respectable 是「值得尊敬的、體面的」，respective 是「各自的」。

subject: english
q: Which base-form verb is related to the noun 'breath'?
explain: breathe 是動詞「呼吸」，breath 是名詞「一口氣、呼吸」；breathless 是形容詞「喘不過氣的」。

subject: english
q: In "telephone," tele- contributes the idea of ____.
explain: tele- 表示「遠方」；telephone 是「電話」，用來進行遠距離通話。

subject: english
q: The lights remained ____ even after the scientists examined them.
explain: remain 後用形容詞 mysterious「神祕的」描述光點；-ous 可形成形容詞，mystery 是名詞「謎」。

subject: english
q: In 'untie the rope,' un- shows that the action of tying is ____.
explain: untie 是「解開」；un- 在動詞 tie「綁」前表示反向動作，不是再次綁或共同綁。

subject: english
q: Rita used to arrive early, but ____ (= recently) she has often been late.
explain: lately 是「最近」，對照從前的習慣；late 是「遲到地」，later 是「稍後」。

subject: english
q: The law promises ____ before the courts, regardless of a person's wealth.
explain: equality 是名詞「平等」；-ity 可形成名詞，equalize 是動詞「使平等」。

subject: english
q: Which adjective means "able to read and write," rather than "related to literature"?
explain: literate 是「識字的、能讀寫的」；literary 是「文學的」，literature 是「文學」。

subject: english
q: The prefix ex- in 'ex-president' means that the person is the current president.
explain: ex-president 是「前總統」；ex- 加在人身分前表示「以前的、前任的」，不是現任。

subject: english
q: According to tomorrow's timetable, the last bus ____ at ten in the evening.
explain: 時間表中的未來班次可用現在簡單式 leaves「出發」；timetable 是「時刻表」。

subject: english
q: Which sentence expresses an arranged future appointment?
choices: I saw my dentist at ten yesterday.
I am seeing my dentist at ten tomorrow.
I have seen my dentist twice.
I was seeing my dentist when you called.
explain: 現在進行式可表示已安排的未來約會；appointment 是「約定」，dentist 是「牙醫」。

subject: english
q: Which prediction is based on visible evidence?
choices: Those clouds are dark. It is going to rain.
I hope it will rain tomorrow.
explain: 烏雲是眼前可見的跡象，is going to rain 表示依跡象預測「將要下雨」；hope 是「希望」，不是證據。

subject: english
q: In "I will carry that heavy box for you," will can introduce an offer.
explain: will 可用於主動提議協助；carry 是「搬運」，offer 是「提議」。

subject: english
q: Which use of will makes a promise?
choices: The weather will probably improve soon.
Will you pass me the salt?
The meeting will begin at nine.
I will pay you back on Friday, I promise.
explain: I promise「我保證」明示還錢承諾；pay you back 是「還你錢」，其餘分別是預測、請求與預定事件。

subject: english
q: In "The car will not start, despite repeated attempts," will not expresses ____.
choices: a failure to work as expected
a habit that ended in the past
a request for someone to start it
explain: will not 可表示人不願意或物品怎樣都不運作；start 在此是「發動」，repeated attempts 是「多次嘗試」。

subject: english
q: In "The phone is ringing; I will answer it," the speaker must have planned the action earlier.
explain: 此處 will 可表示聽到電話響後的當下決定，不必事先規劃；answer the phone 是「接電話」。

subject: english
q: The simple present can express a general truth, as in "Ice melts when heated."
explain: 現在簡單式可陳述普遍成立的現象；ice 是「冰」，melt 是「融化」。

subject: english
q: Why might a live sports commentator say, "Lin passes, Chen shoots"?
choices: Both actions must be daily habits.
The simple present can describe live action.
The speaker is making two promises.
explain: 現場賽事評論可用現在簡單式逐一報導動作；commentator 是「評論員」，shoot 是「射門、投籃」。

subject: english
q: Which sentence uses the simple present to summarize a story?
choices: I am reading the final chapter.
In the final chapter, the hero returns home.
explain: 介紹故事情節常用現在簡單式，即使作者寫的是往事；chapter 是「章」，hero 是「主角、英雄」。

subject: english
q: Did your brother ____ the broken window?
explain: Did 已標示過去，後方主要動詞用原形 notice「注意到」，不能再用過去式。

subject: english
q: In "You are always leaving the door open!", the progressive can express annoyance at a repeated action.
explain: always 搭配進行式可表達對反覆行為的不滿，不只表示此刻的動作；leave the door open 是「讓門開著」。

subject: english
q: Which use of have describes an activity in progress?
explain: have lunch 是「吃午餐」，表示活動，可用進行式；have 表示「擁有」或親屬關係時，通常不用進行式。

subject: english
q: In "I am thinking about the offer," think must mean "hold an opinion" and cannot describe an activity.
explain: think about 是「考慮」，可表示正在思考的活動；think 表示「認為」時才通常不用進行式。

subject: english
q: Which sentence uses the progressive for a temporary living arrangement?
choices: I stayed with Jo last year.
I am staying with Jo while my flat is being painted.
I have stayed with Jo three times.
I usually stay with Jo during holidays.
explain: am staying 在此表示房屋油漆期間的暫時居住安排；temporary 是「暫時的」，flat 是「公寓」。

subject: english
q: This is the first time that I ____ a speech in English.
explain: This is the first time that 後通常用現在完成式，表示截至現在的首次經驗；give a speech 是「演講」。

subject: english
q: In "I have written three reports today," the perfect form counts completed reports.
explain: 現在完成式可計算目前已完成的次數或成果；three reports 是「三份報告」，不是仍在寫的三份。

subject: english
q: In "My sleeves are wet because I have been washing dishes," the verb form emphasizes ____.
choices: An activity completed before another past event.
A habit that ended years ago.
Recent activity with a visible effect now.
explain: 現在完成進行式可解釋剛才活動留下的現況，不一定仍在進行；sleeve 是「袖子」，wash dishes 是「洗碗」。

subject: english
q: In "I have been taking the bus this week," the progressive can describe a temporary repeated activity.
explain: 完成進行式也可表示近期暫時反覆發生的活動，不限單一連續動作；temporary 是「暫時的」。

subject: english
q: Use tense backshift: Ben said, "I will return tomorrow." He said he ____ return the next day.
explain: 過去的引述動詞 said 後，will 可退為 would，表示從過去看未來；the next day 是「隔天」。

subject: english
q: "The teacher said that water freezes at zero degrees Celsius" may keep the present tense for a general truth.
explain: 間接引述若內容仍為普遍事實，可保留現在式；freeze 是「結冰」，degrees Celsius 是「攝氏度」。

subject: english
q: Keep the earlier timing: "I had already eaten," Jo said. Jo said she ____ already eaten.
explain: 直接引語中的過去完成式轉間接引述時通常維持過去完成式；already 是「已經」，eaten 是 eat 的過去分詞。

subject: english
q: "After she locked the door, she left" can use simple past twice because after makes the sequence clear.
explain: after「在……之後」已說清先後，兩動作均可用過去簡單式，不必一律改用過去完成式；lock 是「上鎖」。

subject: english
q: The window ____ by a falling branch last night.
explain: 窗戶昨晚被樹枝打破，用過去簡單式被動 was broken；falling branch 是「掉落的樹枝」。

subject: english
q: "The results will announced tomorrow" contains a complete future passive verb.
explain: 未來被動為 will be 加過去分詞，須補 be：will be announced「將被公布」；result 是「結果」。

subject: english
q: The hall is unavailable now because it ____ for tonight's concert.
explain: 大廳現在正在被布置，用現在進行式被動 is being decorated；unavailable 是「無法使用的」，decorate 是「布置」。

subject: english
q: The old library is going to ____ into a community center next year.
explain: 圖書館將被改建，用 is going to be turned；turn into 是「變成、改造成」，community center 是「社區中心」。

subject: english
q: Before the audit began, all records ____ by an independent team.
explain: 紀錄在過去的稽核開始前已被查核，用過去完成式被動；audit 是「稽核」，independent 是「獨立的」。

subject: english
q: By the time the guests arrive tomorrow, all the meals ____ by the kitchen staff.
explain: 明天客人抵達時餐點將已備妥，用未來完成式被動；prepare 是「準備」，kitchen staff 是「廚房工作人員」。

subject: english
q: Active: "They gave each volunteer a certificate." Which passive keeps the same meaning?
choices: A certificate was given by each volunteer.
Each volunteer was given a certificate.
explain: give 的雙受詞句可讓受領者作被動主詞：Each volunteer was given a certificate；certificate 是「證書」。

subject: english
q: In "A warm coat was bought for the child," the child is identified as the person who bought it.
explain: for the child 指「為孩子」購買，孩子是受益者；本句沒有交代買衣服的人，不能把孩子認定為購買者。

subject: english
q: Active: "They saw the suspect enter the building." Passive: "The suspect was seen ____ the building."
explain: 感官動詞後原為省略 to 的原形，轉被動時補回 to；suspect 是「嫌疑人」，enter 是「進入」。

subject: english
q: The usual passive equivalent of "They let us leave" is "We were let to leave."
explain: let 表允許時，通常改用 We were allowed to leave「我們被允許離開」，不寫 were let to leave；allow 是「允許」。

subject: english
q: Keep the timing: "They say he is ill" becomes "He is said ____ ill."
explain: 報導式被動 is said to be 表示據說目前如此；to have been 則把狀態推到更早，ill 是「生病的」。

subject: english
q: They believe Nora stole the ring. Nora is believed ____ the ring.
explain: 偷戒指早於目前的認定，用完成式不定詞 to have stolen；ring 是「戒指」，steal 是「偷竊」。

subject: english
q: To mean "cared for": The injured bird was looked ____ by the volunteers.
explain: look after 是「照顧」，轉被動仍保留 after；look at 是「看」，look for 是「尋找」，after 後不能再重複加 it。

subject: english
q: In "The cake was cut with a knife by Nina," with marks the tool and by marks the doer.
explain: 被動句用 with 引出「工具」，by 引出「動作執行者」；knife 是「刀」，doer 是「執行者」。

subject: english
q: Which sentence uses an active verb form to describe how easily a product can be washed?
choices: This fabric is washed every week.
This fabric has been washed twice.
explain: washes easily 用主動形式表示「容易清洗」的特性；其餘都是 be 加過去分詞的被動式。fabric 是「布料」。

subject: english
q: In "The door opened suddenly," opened is active in form even though the door is affected.
explain: open 在此是不及物用法，表示「門打開了」；句中沒有 be 加過去分詞的被動結構，也未交代開門原因。

subject: english
q: In "The door remained closed all evening," closed describes ____.
explain: remain 後的 closed 是形容詞，描述門維持關閉的「狀態」，未敘述關門動作；remain 是「保持」。

subject: english
q: Choose the passive form: My phone got ____ when it fell from the shelf.
explain: get 加過去分詞可表被動，常見於遭遇意外；get damaged 是「受損」，shelf 是「架子」。

subject: english
q: The smell of these flowers ____ wonderful.
explain: 主詞核心為單數 smell，不受 of 後的複數 flowers 影響；smell 是「氣味」，wonderful 是「美妙的」。

subject: english
q: The boxes that contain the equipment ____ locked.
explain: 主要子句的主詞是複數 boxes，動詞用 are，不能受子句內的 equipment「設備」影響；locked 是「上鎖的」。

subject: english
q: Each of the tickets ____ a different code.
explain: each of 後雖接複數名詞，主詞核心 each「每一個」仍搭單數動詞 has；code 是「代碼」。

subject: english
q: "The players each have a locker" correctly uses have because the subject players is plural.
explain: each 位於複數主詞後，補充分別的意思，不改變主詞 players 的複數性；locker 是「置物櫃」。

subject: english
q: Sixty percent of the students ____ brought reusable bottles.
explain: 百分比的動詞依 of 後名詞決定；students 是複數，用 have，reusable bottles 是「可重複使用的水瓶」。

subject: english
q: Which sentence has correct subject-verb agreement?
choices: Forty percent of the land are covered with trees.
Forty percent of the trees is very old.
Forty percent of the water are clean.
Forty percent of the land is covered with trees.
explain: 百分比後的 land「土地」為不可數名詞，動詞用單數 is；covered with 是「覆蓋著」。

subject: english
q: In "I have lost my key, so I cannot unlock the door," the present perfect connects ____.
choices: a past event with a present problem
a future action with a past result
a daily action with no time reference
explain: have lost 把先前遺失鑰匙與現在無法開門連結；lose 是「遺失」，unlock 是「開鎖」。

subject: english
q: In "We lived there for ten years before moving away," for ten years requires a present perfect verb.
explain: for ten years 只交代「長達十年」；before moving away 表示居住已結束，因此用過去簡單式 lived 正確。

subject: english
q: Which sentence has no passive counterpart with the same verb?
explain: arrive「到達」是不及物動詞，沒有受詞可改作被動主詞；repair「修理」、chase「追逐」、announce「宣布」都是及物動詞。

subject: english
q: Which question correctly asks when the stadium was built?
choices: When did the stadium was built?
explain: 被動問句把 was 放在主詞前，後接 built，不再加 did；stadium 是「體育場」，build 是「建造」。

subject: english
q: Swimming in these rough waters ____ dangerous.
explain: 動名詞片語作單一活動的主詞，搭單數動詞 is；rough waters 是「波濤洶湧的水域」，dangerous 是「危險的」。

subject: english
q: In "If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home," rains can refer to future time.
explain: 表示可能發生的未來條件時，if 子句用現在式 rains，主要子句可用 will；stay home 是「待在家」。

subject: english
q: One person holds both roles: "The owner and chef ____ welcoming guests."
explain: 題幹明說老闆兼主廚為同一人，and 連接兩個身分仍用單數 is；owner 是「老闆」，chef 是「主廚」。

subject: english
q: At the moment, both the singer and the dancers ____ waiting backstage.
explain: both ... and ... 連接兩組主詞，搭複數 are；不可只看較近的名詞套用其他連接結構。backstage 是「後臺」。

subject: english
q: As one dish, fish and chips ____ my favorite meal.
explain: fish and chips「炸魚薯條」在此視為一道餐點，搭單數動詞；meal 是「餐點」。

subject: english
q: A novel titled "The Silent Streets" requires a plural verb because its title ends in a plural noun.
explain: 作品名稱代表單一作品，須搭單數動詞，不依名稱末字決定；novel 是「小說」，title 是「名稱」。

subject: english
q: As a field of study, statistics ____ useful for interpreting survey results.
explain: statistics 指「統計學」這門學科時搭單數動詞；survey results 是「調查結果」，interpret 是「解讀」。

subject: english
q: These statistics ____ the number of visitors each month.
explain: statistics 指「各項統計數據」時為複數，與「統計學」不同；these 明示複數，visitor 是「訪客」。

subject: english
q: Choose the pair that makes both verbs agree: The student whose parents ____ abroad ____ with her aunt.
explain: parents 是複數，子句用 work；主句的 The student 是單數，用 lives。abroad 是「在國外」，aunt 是「阿姨、姑姑等」。

subject: english
q: Use tense backshift: At noon Ana said, "I am working." Ana said she ____ then.
explain: 依題意退時，am working 改為 was working，表示說話當時正在工作；then 是「當時」。

subject: english
q: What the witness said ____ surprising.
explain: What the witness said 整個名詞子句表示一件事，搭單數動詞；witness 是「目擊者」，surprising 是「令人驚訝的」。

subject: english
q: To ask which people own them: "Who ____ the owners of these bags?"
explain: Who 問身分且補語為複數 the owners 時用 are；owner 是「所有人」，bag 是「袋子」。

subject: english
q: There ____ only one seat left in the front row.
explain: there 存在句的動詞與後方真正主詞一致；one seat 是單數，front row 是「前排」。

subject: english
q: Here ____ the winners of the competition!
explain: Here 開頭的地方副詞倒裝仍須配合後面的主詞；winners 為複數，competition 是「比賽」。

subject: english
q: Many a traveler ____ lost luggage at least once.
explain: many a 加單數名詞，雖有「許多」之意，動詞仍用單數 has；traveler 是「旅客」，luggage 是「行李」。

subject: english
q: More than one applicant ____ qualified for this position.
explain: more than one 加單數名詞，慣用單數動詞；applicant 是「申請者」，qualified 是「符合資格的」。

subject: english
q: One of these paintings ____ belonged to my grandfather for years.
explain: one of 加複數名詞，核心主詞仍是單數 one，搭 has；painting 是「畫作」，belong to 是「屬於」。

subject: english
q: In "As a child, I would sit by the window every rainy day," would describes ____.
choices: an action continuing up to now
explain: 配合 As a child 與 every rainy day，would 表示「過去常常」做的事；sit by the window 是「坐在窗邊」。

subject: english
q: Only one species of frog ____ found on that island.
explain: species「物種」單複數同形，one 明示單數，故用 is；island 是「島嶼」。

subject: english
q: In "No student has handed in the form," no makes the subject grammatically plural.
explain: no 不必然使主詞變複數；No student 的 student 是單數，所以用 has。hand in 是「繳交」。

subject: english
q: The elderly ____ entitled to use this service.
explain: the 加形容詞 elderly 表示一群「年長者」，用複數動詞；be entitled to 是「有權享有」。

subject: english
q: The unknown ____ often more frightening than the familiar.
explain: the unknown 指抽象的「未知事物」整體，用單數動詞，不同於指人群的 the elderly；familiar 是「熟悉的」。

subject: english
q: In "The Smiths have arrived," Smiths names one family, so the verb must be singular.
explain: the 加姓氏複數表示「一家人」，動詞用複數，不因是一個家庭而改單數；arrive 是「抵達」。

subject: english
q: We stayed in a hotel ____ roof was covered with plants.
explain: whose 可修飾事物，whose roof 是「其屋頂」，不限人的所有關係；hotel 是「旅館」。

subject: english
q: The old house, the roof ____ had collapsed, was finally repaired.
explain: the roof of which 相當於 whose roof，表示房子的屋頂；collapse 是「倒塌」，repair 是「修復」。

subject: english
q: Which sentence correctly leaves the preposition at the end of a relative clause?
choices: This is the bed which I slept in.
This is the bed in which I slept in.
This is the bed which I slept it in.
This is the bed in which I slept it.
explain: 介系詞 in 可留在關係子句末，不可重複 in 或受詞 it；sleep in 是「睡在……裡」，bed 是「床」。

subject: english
q: In "Where we stay depends on the price," Where we stay is the subject of depends.
explain: Where we stay 是名詞子句，作 depends 的主詞，意為「我們住哪裡」；depend on 是「取決於」。

subject: english
q: Six students applied, two of ____ had previous experience.
explain: 數量詞加 of 引導非限定關係子句，指人用 whom；此處不可用 them 直接連兩子句，previous experience 是「先前經驗」。

subject: english
q: She showed me three maps, all of ____ were hand-drawn.
explain: all of which 以關係結構補充說明三張地圖，不能以 all of them 只靠逗號連句；hand-drawn 是「手繪的」。

subject: english
q: Which relative pronoun cannot be omitted from its sentence?
choices: whom in "The nurse whom I met was kind."
that in "The card that I bought was blue."
which in "The song which I heard was new."
who in "The nurse who helped me was kind."
explain: who 在 helped 前作子句主詞，不可省；其他選項的關係代名詞都作受詞。nurse 是「護理師」。

subject: english
q: Which sentence avoids repeating the relative clause's object?
choices: The wallet that I found was empty.
The wallet that I found it was empty.
The wallet which I found it was empty.
The wallet I found it was empty.
explain: 關係代名詞已代表 found 的受詞 wallet，不可再加 it；wallet 是「皮夾」，empty 是「空的」。

subject: english
q: "My cousins who live nearby visit often." Which cousins does the relative clause identify?
choices: Only cousins visiting for the first time.
explain: 無逗號的限定關係子句限縮 cousins 的範圍，指住附近的那些人；nearby 是「附近」，identify 是「指出」。

subject: english
q: In "Leo, whom you met yesterday, called me," whom may be omitted while keeping the commas.
explain: 非限定關係子句的關係代名詞不能省略，即使 whom 在子句中作受詞；met 是「見過」，called 是「打電話給」。

subject: english
q: The woman ____ I thought was our guide turned out to be a tourist.
explain: I thought 後的 was 缺主詞，關係代名詞用主格 who，不因靠近 thought 就用 whom；guide 是「導遊」。

subject: english
q: The woman ____ I thought we had invited never arrived.
explain: we 已是 had invited 的主詞，缺受詞，指人用受格 whom；invite 是「邀請」，arrive 是「抵達」。

subject: english
q: You may order ____ you like from the menu; there are no restrictions.
explain: whatever 表示「任何……的東西」，可作 order 的受詞；menu 是「菜單」，restriction 是「限制」。

subject: english
q: Choose one of these two seats. Take ____ you prefer.
explain: whichever 指在已限定範圍中「無論哪一個」；題幹已限定兩張座位，prefer 是「較喜歡」。

subject: english
q: I was amazed at ____ quickly she solved the puzzle.
explain: how quickly 表示「多麼迅速」，整個子句補充驚訝的內容；how 修飾副詞 quickly，amazed 是「驚訝的」。

subject: english
q: In "No matter who calls, stay calm," the instruction applies only to calls from certain people.
explain: No matter who calls 意為「無論誰來電」，並不限特定人士；stay calm 是「保持冷靜」。

subject: english
q: I believe ____ we can finish this project together.
explain: that 引導完整的受詞內容子句，沒有替代子句內的名詞；believe 是「相信」，project 是「專題、計畫」。

subject: english
q: In "I am glad that you came," that introduces the content of the feeling, not a relative clause.
explain: that you came 補充形容詞 glad 的內容，前面沒有供 that 修飾的名詞；glad 是「高興的」。

subject: english
q: ____ we can finish on time remains uncertain.
explain: 表示「是否」的子句放句首作主詞時，用 whether，不用 if；on time 是「準時」，uncertain 是「不確定的」。

subject: english
q: We have not decided ____ to cancel the trip.
explain: whether 可直接接 to 不定詞表示「是否要……」，if 不可；cancel the trip 是「取消旅行」。

subject: english
q: In "Give the ticket to whoever needs it," to makes whomever necessary in place of whoever.
explain: to 的受詞是整個子句；whoever 仍是 needs 的主詞，不能改成受格 whomever。whoever needs it 是「任何需要它的人」。

subject: english
q: To ask about a person: Do you know ____ broke the glass?
explain: who 本身是 broke 的主詞，不加 did，也不用受格 whom；break the glass 是「打破玻璃杯」。

subject: english
q: In "Tell me what happened," what functions as ____.
explain: what 在嵌入問句中直接作 happened 的主詞，不另加主詞或 do；happen 是「發生」。

subject: english
q: Tell me ____ you left early. Was it because you felt sick?
explain: 後句詢問是否因生病而早退，可知要問原因，用 why「為什麼」；leave early 是「提早離開」。

subject: english
q: We need to know ____ far the nearest hospital is.
explain: how 修飾 far 表示距離程度，how far 是「多遠」；nearest hospital 是「最近的醫院」。

subject: english
q: Please check how ____ chairs we need for the visitors.
explain: chairs 是可數名詞複數，詢問數量用 how many「多少個」；visitor 是「訪客」。

subject: english
q: The invitation is open: Visit us ____ you like, regardless of the time.
explain: whenever 在此表示「無論何時」，提供不受特定時間限制的選擇；regardless of 是「不管」。

subject: english
q: "Wherever you travel, respect local customs" requires respect at every destination.
explain: wherever 表示「無論到哪裡」，要求在任何目的地都尊重習俗；local customs 是「當地習俗」。

subject: english
q: In "The rumor that spread quickly was false," that functions as ____.
choices: a marker of a complete content clause
explain: spread 前缺主詞，that 在關係子句作主詞；不是只介紹內容的同位語 that。rumor 是「傳言」，spread 是「傳播」。

subject: english
q: In "The rumor that the store would close proved false," that is the subject of would close.
explain: would close 的主詞已是 the store；that 引導同位語子句，說明傳言內容。prove false 是「證實為假」。

subject: english
q: In "If the weather improves, we will sail," the if-clause states ____.
explain: 此處 if 是「如果」，子句提出出航條件，不是表示「是否」的名詞子句；sail 是「航行」。

subject: english
q: "I wonder if the shop is open" asserts that the shop is definitely open.
explain: wonder if 是「想知道是否」，沒有斷言商店一定營業；open 在此是「營業中的」，definitely 是「確定地」。

subject: english
q: The match was canceled ____ the field was flooded.
explain: 空格後是完整子句，原因連接詞用 because「因為」；field 是「場地」，flooded 是「淹水的」。

subject: english
q: The match was canceled ____ the heavy rain.
explain: 空格後只有名詞片語 the heavy rain，原因片語用 because of「因為」；heavy rain 是「大雨」。

subject: english
q: To express a result: The road was blocked, ____ we took another route.
explain: so 連接原因與其結果，表示「所以」；for 引出原因，blocked 是「受阻的」，route 是「路線」。

subject: english
q: In "We hurried, for the train was about to leave," for introduces the reason for hurrying.
explain: 對等連接詞 for 可補充前句理由，意為「因為」；hurry 是「趕快」，be about to 是「即將」。

subject: english
q: Use the same past tense: Mia did not complain, nor ____.
explain: nor 連接否定子句時，助動詞置於主詞前，並呼應過去式 did；complain 是「抱怨」，teammate 是「隊友」。

subject: english
q: In formal writing, two independent clauses can generally be joined by a comma alone, with no conjunction.
explain: 一般正式寫作不應只靠逗號連接兩個獨立子句；可加連接詞或改用分號、句號，特殊慣用句另論。independent clause 是「獨立子句」。

subject: english
q: To offer alternatives: Would you like tea ____ coffee?
explain: or 可連接可選方案，表示「或是」；alternative 是「選項」，tea 是「茶」，coffee 是「咖啡」。

subject: english
q: To warn of a consequence: Hurry up, ____ you will miss the bus.
explain: 祈使句後接 or 表示「否則」，提出不照做的後果；hurry up 是「快一點」，miss the bus 是「錯過公車」。

subject: english
q: "She does not eat fish or meat" normally means she eats neither fish nor meat.
explain: 否定句中的 not ... or ... 通常否定兩項，表示魚和肉都不吃；fish 是「魚肉」，meat 是「肉」。

subject: english
q: To add another ability: The robot can recognize faces ____ understand speech.
explain: and 可連接兩個並列原形動詞，共用 can，表示「而且、也」；recognize 是「辨識」，speech 是「語音」。

subject: english
q: In "Press this button, and the screen will light up," and connects the instruction with ____.
explain: 祈使句加 and 可表示照做後的結果；press 是「按」，light up 是「亮起」。

subject: english
q: You can choose either the red folder ____ the blue one.
explain: either ... or ... 表示「不是……就是……、兩者擇一」；folder 是「資料夾」，choose 是「選擇」。

subject: english
q: It was not anger ____ fear that made his hands shake.
explain: not ... but ... 用後項更正前項，表示「不是……而是……」；anger 是「憤怒」，fear 是「恐懼」。

subject: english
q: "Although the test was difficult, but I passed" correctly uses both conjunctions in standard written English.
explain: although 與 but 不可如此重複連接同一對子句，刪除 but 即可；difficult 是「困難的」，pass 是「通過」。

subject: english
q: Which correction removes the redundant conjunction in "Because it rained, so we stayed home"?
explain: because 已引導原因子句，主要子句不再加 so；刪 so 即可，redundant 是「多餘的」，stay home 是「待在家」。

subject: english
q: First wash your hands; then eat. Eat only ____ you have washed your hands.
explain: 先洗手後吃飯，用 after「在……之後」；before 會反轉先後，wash your hands 是「洗手」。

subject: english
q: In "When the lights go out, the alarm starts," when can describe a repeated situation rather than one event.
explain: when 可引導每逢某情況就發生的反覆事件，不限單次過去事件；go out 在此是「熄滅」，alarm 是「警報」。

subject: english
q: To mean she began only when it became quiet: She did not begin speaking ____ the room was quiet.
explain: not ... until ... 表示「直到……才……」，安靜後才開始說話；quiet 是「安靜的」。

subject: english
q: To mean "no later than their arrival": ____ the firefighters arrived, the neighbors had already put out the fire.
explain: by the time 以消防員抵達為截止參照，火在那時已被撲滅；firefighter 是「消防員」，put out 是「撲滅」。

subject: english
q: In "The lamp stayed on as long as the battery lasted," as long as describes ____.
explain: 此處 as long as 指電池能撐多久燈就亮多久，表持續時間；duration 是「期間」，last 是「持續、撐住」。

subject: english
q: In "I have felt better since I changed my routine," since introduces a starting point in time.
explain: since 在此是「自從」，標示感覺改善的時間起點；change my routine 是「改變作息」。

subject: english
q: In "Once payment is confirmed, we will ship," which event must come first?
choices: Neither event has a required order.
explain: once 是「一旦」，付款確認後才出貨；payment confirmation 是「付款確認」，ship 在此是「出貨」。

subject: english
q: In "The moment the gate opened, people rushed in," the moment means ____.
explain: the moment 可作連接詞，表示「一……就……」，強調緊接發生；rush in 是「衝進去」。

subject: english
q: To give a reason based on a new situation: ____ you have a license, you can drive us.
explain: now that 意為「既然現在……」，用取得駕照的新情況提供理由；license 是「駕照」。

subject: english
q: "Seeing that everyone has eaten, we can leave" gives a reason for leaving.
explain: seeing that 可引導已知的理由，意為「既然、鑑於」；everyone has eaten 是「每個人都吃過了」。

subject: english
q: We do not know whether it will rain. To show an unchanged plan: We will go ____ it rains.
explain: even if 表示「即使」，可讓步於尚未確定的情況；even though 通常把子句當已知事實，unchanged 是「不變的」。

subject: english
q: "Even though she was ill, she attended" presents her illness as a fact, not merely a possibility.
explain: even though「雖然、儘管」把生病當已知事實；even if 才可提出未確定假設，attend 是「出席」。

subject: english
q: ____ the figures are accurate, the project will stay within budget; this is only a working assumption.
explain: assuming that 引導暫時採用的前提，意為「假設」；accurate 是「準確的」，within budget 是「在預算內」。

subject: english
q: "In case of it rains, use the shelter" correctly follows in case of with a complete clause.
explain: in case of 後接名詞，可寫 in case of rain；完整子句則用 in case it rains。shelter 是「遮蔽處」。

subject: english
q: Do ____ the safety guide says; follow each step exactly.
explain: as 引導方式副詞子句，表示「按照……的方式」；Do as the safety guide says 是「照安全指南所說的做」。

subject: english
q: The repair cost more ____ we had expected.
explain: 比較級 more 後以 than 引導比較子句；repair 是「修理」，expect 是「預期」。

subject: english
q: It was ____ a helpful guide that we kept it for years.
explain: such 加 a 與形容詞、名詞，再接 that 結果子句；such a helpful guide 是「如此有用的一本指南」。

subject: english
q: There were ____ few seats that several guests had to stand.
explain: few 修飾複數名詞時用 so few ... that，表示「少到……」；seat 是「座位」，guest 是「客人」。

subject: english
q: It looks ____ someone has already used this notebook.
explain: as if 引導表象判斷，意為「看起來好像」，後接完整子句；notebook 是「筆記本」。

subject: english
q: In "You may walk as far as you like," as far as sets a limit of time.
explain: as far as 在此表示「遠到……」，修飾步行距離，不是時間長短；walk 是「步行」。

subject: english
q: Put your bicycle ____ it will not block the entrance.
explain: where 可直接引導地點副詞子句，表示「在……的地方」，不必有先行詞；block the entrance 是「擋住入口」。

subject: english
q: I need somewhere ____ offers free parking.
explain: somewhere 雖表示「某個地方」，offers 仍缺主詞，須用關係代名詞 that，不能用 where；free parking 是「免費停車」。

subject: english
q: To contrast preferences: I enjoy team sports, ____ my brother prefers individual ones.
explain: while 除了表同時，也可表對比，意為「然而、而」；team sports 是「團隊運動」，individual 是「個人的」。

subject: english
q: In "As the sun rose, the sky grew brighter," as can link changes occurring at the same time.
explain: as 在此可解為「隨著」，連接太陽升起與天空變亮的同步變化；rise 是「升起」，brighter 是「更明亮的」。

subject: english
q: In "Ella opened the door and waved," who performed the second action?
choices: The sentence gives no subject for either action.
explain: 兩個並列動詞共用主詞 Ella，第二個動作可省去重複主詞；wave 是「揮手」。

subject: english
q: In "Mia ordered tea, and Ben coffee," which word is understood before coffee?
explain: 對等子句可省略可由前文補出的相同動詞，Ben 後省去 ordered；order 是「點餐」，coffee 是「咖啡」。

subject: english
q: "Because the bus was late" is a complete standalone sentence in standard written English.
explain: because 引導從屬原因子句，單獨書寫通常是句子片段，須接主要子句；standalone 是「獨立的」，late 是「遲到的」。

subject: english
q: After checking the weather, we decided ____ the picnic indoors.
explain: decide to V 是「決定做……」，後接不定詞；hold a picnic 是「舉辦野餐」。

subject: english
q: In 'I managed to finish the race,' finishing the race actually happened.
explain: manage to V 表示「設法成功做到……」，不是只嘗試；finish the race 是「完成比賽」。

subject: english
q: The guide suggested visiting the museum. The guide ____.
choices: promised to work at the museum
explain: suggest V-ing 是「建議做……」，此處建議的是參觀博物館這件事；recommend 是「建議、推薦」。

subject: english
q: In 'She enjoys reading,' 'reading' shows that she is reading at this very moment.
explain: reading 是 enjoy「喜歡」的動名詞受詞，只指閱讀這種活動，不表示此刻正在讀；進行式須有 be + V-ing。

subject: english
q: Please ask before borrowing my things; do not take them without ____ me.
explain: without 是「沒有、未經」，介系詞後接動名詞 telling；without telling me 是「沒告訴我」。

subject: english
q: 'They stopped arguing' means they continued the argument.
explain: stop V-ing 是「停止做……」，因此爭論已停下；argue 是「爭論」。

subject: english
q: In 'I remember meeting Lea,' the meeting happened before the remembering.
explain: remember V-ing 是「記得曾做過……」，見面先發生，後來才回想；meet 是「見面」。

subject: english
q: I forgot ____ the file to you; it is still unsent.
explain: forget to send 是「忘記去寄」，與 unsent「尚未寄出」一致；forget sending 則表示忘了自己曾寄過。

subject: english
q: In 'After introducing herself, Lea went on to explain the rules,' she moved to the next part of her talk.
explain: go on to V 是「接著做另一件事」；她自我介紹後接著解釋規則。go on V-ing 則是「繼續做原來的事」。

subject: english
q: The screen is frozen. Try ____ the computer; a restart may solve the problem.
explain: try V-ing 表示「試試某種方法」，重開機是解決問題的方法；restart 是「重新啟動」。

subject: english
q: To describe an action in progress: He seems ____ a shower right now.
explain: to be taking 是進行式不定詞，表示「似乎正在洗澡」，符合 right now「此刻」；to have taken 則表示先前已洗過。

subject: english
q: 'I tried to call Ben' guarantees that I spoke with Ben.
explain: try to V 是「努力、試圖做……」，不保證成功接通；call 是「打電話」，guarantee 是「保證」。

subject: english
q: 'I regret shouting at Sam' means I plan to shout at Sam later.
explain: regret V-ing 是「後悔曾做……」，不是未來計畫；shout at 是「對……大吼」。

subject: english
q: I meant to reply yesterday, but I forgot. Replying yesterday was ____.
choices: something I had refused to do
explain: mean to V 是「打算做……」，後句說忘了，故只是原本的意圖；reply 是「回覆」。

subject: english
q: We spoke quietly so as ____ the sleeping baby.
explain: so as not to V 是「為了不……」，用不定詞表否定目的；wake 是「弄醒」。

subject: english
q: Nora was delighted ____ that her missing dog was safe.
explain: delighted to V 是「很高興得知或做……」，不定詞說明高興的原因；learn 在此是「得知」。

subject: english
q: In 'It is hard for Leo to wait,' 'for Leo' identifies the person being waited for.
explain: for Leo 指執行 wait「等待」的人是 Leo，不是被等待的人；hard 是「困難的」。

subject: english
q: With all that noise, I found ____ difficult to concentrate.
explain: find it difficult to V 的 it 是虛受詞，真正受詞是後面的不定詞；concentrate 是「專心」。

subject: english
q: In 'I find it relaxing to draw,' 'it' fills the object position before the activity is stated.
explain: it 是虛受詞，先占受詞位置，實際內容由 to draw「畫畫」補充；不是代替前文某件物品。relaxing 是「令人放鬆的」。

subject: english
q: Lena told Max, 'Remind me to bring an umbrella.' The person meant to bring it is ____.
explain: remind me to V 是「提醒我去做……」，me 指說話的 Lena；Max 負責提醒，Lena 負責帶傘。

subject: english
q: 'The guard allowed us to enter' says we received permission to go in.
explain: allow someone to V 是「允許某人做……」，獲得許可的人是 us「我們」；enter 是「進入」。

subject: english
q: The offer has both benefits and risks, so I cannot decide ____ accept it.
explain: whether to V 是「是否要做……」；if 不能直接接不定詞，accept 是「接受」。

subject: english
q: Several buses stop here. Please tell me ____ to catch for the airport.
explain: which bus to catch 是「該搭哪班公車」，which bus 整體作 catch 的受詞；airport 是「機場」。

subject: english
q: I am thirsty. Is there anything ____?
explain: anything to drink 是「可以喝的東西」，不定詞後置修飾 anything；thirsty 是「口渴的」。

subject: english
q: This room needs a comfortable chair ____ during long meetings.
explain: sit on a chair 是「坐在椅子上」，chair 被提前後仍須保留 on，不能再加重複受詞 it。

subject: english
q: In 'Learning takes time,' 'Learning' functions as the subject.
explain: Learning 是作主詞的動名詞，表示「學習」這件事；takes time 是「需要時間」。

subject: english
q: Mia collects stamps. Her favorite hobby is ____.
explain: collecting stamps「集郵」是動名詞片語，在此說明 hobby「嗜好」的內容，不是正在集郵。

subject: english
q: 'I dislike his interrupting me' remains grammatical if 'his' is replaced by 'he'.
explain: 動名詞前可用所有格 his 表示動作者，不能換成主格 he；interrupt 是「打斷」，dislike 是「不喜歡」。

subject: english
q: The print is tiny, so Grandpa has trouble ____ the label.
explain: have trouble V-ing 是「做……有困難」，後接動名詞；label 是「標籤」，tiny 是「極小的」。

subject: english
q: 'She had trouble starting the car' proves that the car never started.
explain: have trouble V-ing 只表示「做……有困難」，不能推論最後一定失敗；start the car 是「發動車子」。

subject: english
q: In 'He denied having copied the answer,' the copying is presented as ____ the denial.
explain: having copied 是完成動名詞，將抄答案置於否認之前；deny「否認」不表示抄襲真的發生。

subject: english
q: These glass bottles must stay dry; they need ____ carefully.
explain: 瓶子是「被存放」的一方，用被動不定詞 to be stored；store 是「存放」，carefully 是「小心地」。

subject: english
q: 'The documents are ready to be signed' presents the documents as receiving the action.
explain: to be signed 是「待簽署、被簽名」，documents「文件」接受動作，不是自己簽名。

subject: english
q: The runner seems ____ before the race began; his ankle was already swollen.
explain: to have been injured 同時表「先前已受傷」及被動；受傷早於比賽開始，swollen 是「腫起的」。

subject: english
q: The joke was so funny that I could not help ____.
explain: cannot help V-ing 是「忍不住做……」；laugh 是「笑」，不是 help「幫助」的一般用法。

subject: english
q: 'I couldn't help laughing' means I was unable to help another person laugh.
explain: cannot help V-ing 是「忍不住……」，could not help laughing 是「忍不住笑了」，不是無法幫別人。

subject: english
q: Not having met the speaker before, I failed to recognize her. The opening phrase states that I ____.
choices: was not meeting her at that moment
had met her but forgotten her name
explain: Not having met 是否定完成分詞，表示在認不出她之前未曾見面；recognize 是「辨認出」。

subject: english
q: In 'The guests are eager to please,' the guests ____.
choices: are easy for others to satisfy
must be made happy by others
explain: eager to please 指「渴望取悅別人」，guests 執行 please；easy to please 才是「容易被取悅」。

subject: english
q: 'Let me leave' asks the listener to force the speaker to go away.
explain: let someone V 是「讓、允許某人……」，此處請求允許離開，不是強迫；leave 是「離開」。

subject: english
q: The teacher made us ____ the sentence after her.
explain: 主動使役 make 後接「受詞 + 原形動詞」，故用 repeat「重複」。

subject: english
q: In 'She was heard to sing,' 'to sing' is a correct infinitive form after the passive verb.
explain: 感官動詞 hear 改為此類被動句時，可用 be heard to V；to sing 是「唱歌」。主動句則用 heard her sing，不加 to。

subject: english
q: The manager had her assistant ____ the customers about the delay.
explain: have + 人 + 原形動詞 是「請某人做……」，此處由 assistant「助理」打電話；delay 是「延誤」。

subject: english
q: 'The joke had everyone laughing' says that everyone was being laughed at.
explain: have + 受詞 + V-ing 可表示使某人持續做某動作；此處是大家在笑，不是大家被嘲笑。joke 是「笑話」。

subject: english
q: I finally got my brother ____ me carry the heavy desk.
explain: get + 人 + to V 是「使、說服某人做……」，與 make 或 have 後接原形不同；carry 是「搬」。

subject: english
q: The window was cracked, so we got it ____ yesterday.
explain: get + 受詞 + 過去分詞 可表示「請人處理……」；窗戶是被換掉的，replace 是「更換」。

subject: english
q: Nina had her wallet stolen on the bus. This describes something she ____.
explain: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞 也可表「遭遇」；錢包遭竊，不表示請人去偷。stolen 是「被偷走的」。

subject: english
q: Could you help me ____ these boxes upstairs?
explain: help someone V 或 help someone to V 都正確；此處可用 carry「搬運」，upstairs 是「到樓上」。

subject: english
q: Both 'help me move' and 'help me to move' are standard English.
explain: help 後的 to 可有可無，所以兩句都可表示「幫我搬動」；move 是「搬動」。

subject: english
q: I saw Mia cross the finish line. The base form presents the crossing as ____.
choices: an event heard but not seen
explain: 感官動詞後的原形 cross 著重看見完整事件；cross the finish line 是「越過終點線」。

subject: english
q: In 'I heard May sing,' 'sing' is ____.
explain: heard 後接受詞 May 與無 to 的不定詞 sing「唱歌」，句中的主要過去式動詞是 heard「聽到」。

subject: english
q: I saw my name ____ in large letters on the invitation.
explain: name「名字」是被印出來的，感官動詞後用「受詞 + 過去分詞」printed；invitation 是「邀請函」。

subject: english
q: I heard my name called. The sentence leaves ____ unidentified.
explain: my name 是被叫出的內容，主詞 I 是聽者；句子未交代誰叫名字。called 在此是「被叫出」。

subject: english
q: For a speech causing boredom and listeners feeling boredom, use ____ respectively.
explain: boring 是「令人無聊的」，形容演講；bored 是「感到無聊的」，形容聽眾的感受。

subject: english
q: A person described as 'boring' can make other people feel bored.
explain: boring 是「令人無聊的」，也可形容人的特質；不能只看名詞是人就選 bored「感到無聊的」。

subject: english
q: The gardener swept the ____ leaves off the path after they had dropped from the trees.
explain: fallen leaves 是「落葉」，fallen 表示已掉落的狀態；falling 則是「正在掉落的」。

subject: english
q: To stress that water is bubbling right now, call it ____ water.
explain: boiling water 是「正在沸騰的水」；boiled water 是「煮過的水」，未必仍在沸騰。bubble 是「冒泡」。

subject: english
q: The missing child is believed ____ safe with relatives.
explain: be believed to V 是「被認為……」，此處用 to be safe「是安全的」；relatives 是「親戚」。

subject: english
q: To describe a future task: The bridge ____ next year will connect the villages.
explain: to be built next year 是「明年將被建造的」，被動不定詞後置修飾 bridge「橋」，說明尚待完成的工作。

subject: english
q: ____ a tune, Jay washed the dishes after dinner.
explain: Humming a tune 是「哼著曲子」，Jay 主動哼歌並洗碗，用現在分詞表同時動作；hum 是「哼唱」。

subject: english
q: Knowing a shortcut, we arrived early. Our early arrival was helped by ____.
choices: our decision to take the longest route
our knowledge of a shorter route
explain: Knowing a shortcut 是「因為知道捷徑」，分詞構句在此表原因；shortcut 是「捷徑」。

subject: english
q: Used carefully, this tool is safe. Here, used carefully means ____.
explain: Used carefully 在此等於 if it is used carefully「如果被小心使用」，分詞構句表條件；tool 是「工具」。

subject: english
q: To express receiving an earlier warning: ____ about the icy road, we drove slowly.
explain: 警告已先發生，且 we 是被警告者，用 Having been warned「先前已被警告」；icy 是「結冰的」。

subject: english
q: While ____ for the bus, Emma reviewed her notes.
explain: While waiting 是 While Emma was waiting 的省略，主詞與主句相同；review notes 是「複習筆記」。

subject: english
q: The crowd was cheering. With the crowd ____, the players ran onto the field.
explain: with + 受詞 + V-ing 可表伴隨狀態；crowd「群眾」主動 cheer「歡呼」，故用 cheering。

subject: english
q: None of the windows was open. We kept the room warm with all the windows ____.
explain: with + 受詞 + 過去分詞 表狀態；windows「窗戶」是被關上的，用 closed「關著的」。

subject: english
q: 'Weather permitting, we will eat outside' means we will eat outside ____.
explain: Weather permitting 是「天氣允許的話」，weather 是 permitting 的主詞；這是表條件的獨立分詞構句。

subject: english
q: The storm knocked out the power, ____ the village in darkness.
explain: leaving 引出停電的結果「使村莊陷入黑暗」；knock out the power 是「使電力中斷」。

subject: english
q: A pipe burst, flooding the kitchen. Flooding the kitchen was ____ of the burst.
explain: flooding the kitchen 是前面爆管所造成的結果，不是目的；burst 是「爆裂」，flood 是「淹沒」。

subject: english
q: Most people dislike ____ as if they were invisible.
explain: 人是被對待的一方，dislike 後用被動動名詞 being treated「被對待」；invisible 是「看不見的」。

subject: english
q: I remember being praised by Ms. Lin. Ms. Lin was ____.
choices: the person who heard my praise of others
the person who remembered my words
explain: being praised 是「被稱讚」，by Ms. Lin 指執行稱讚的人；主詞 I 則是被稱讚者。

subject: english
q: She spoke clearly because she was worried about ____ by the audience.
explain: about 是介系詞，後接動名詞；她擔心「被誤解」，故用 being misunderstood，audience 是「觀眾」。

subject: english
q: We packed our tents and sleeping bags because we planned to go ____ by the lake.
explain: go camping 是「去露營」，go 後接活動的 V-ing；tent 是「帳篷」，sleeping bag 是「睡袋」。

subject: english
q: The -ing form in 'We went hiking' identifies ____.
explain: go hiking 是「去健行」，hiking 指所進行的活動，不是目的地或同行者；activity 是「活動」。

subject: english
q: In 'If I lived nearby, I would walk to school,' the past form can describe an imagined present.
explain: lived 在此可表想像中的現在狀況，不一定指過去；nearby 是「在附近」，would walk 是假設的結果。

subject: english
q: Owen has no car. Imagine a different present: If he owned one, he ____ us there.
explain: 假設現在有車，現在的能力結果用 could drive「就能開車載」；owned 是「擁有」。

subject: english
q: 'If I had read the label, I would not have washed it.' The speaker suggests that they ____.
choices: read the label and washed it
read the label and left it unwashed
did not read or wash anything
washed it without reading the label
explain: 過去反事實句暗示當時沒讀標籤，卻洗了那件物品；label 是「標籤」。

subject: english
q: 'If the road had not been icy, we would not have crashed' implies that the road was dry.
explain: 此句是在假設「路面沒有結冰」的情況，並未表示實際路面乾燥；icy 是「結冰的」，dry 是「乾燥的」。

subject: english
q: In 'If I had saved more last year, I would be less worried now,' the imagined result concerns the present.
explain: 條件談去年，結果由 now 指向現在；worried 是「擔心的」。

subject: english
q: If Leo were not afraid of heights, he ____ us on the tower yesterday.
explain: 一般特質是怕高，假設結果在昨天，須用 would have joined「當時本來會加入」。

subject: english
q: 'I wish I could swim' suggests that the speaker ____.
explain: wish I could swim 暗示目前不會游泳；could 在此表示未實現的「能夠」。

subject: english
q: In 'I wish my room were larger,' were means the wish is about a room in the past.
explain: were 表示與現況相反，願望仍可談現在；larger 是「更大的」。

subject: english
q: 'I wish I had checked the address' suggests that the speaker ____.
explain: wish 加過去完成式表過去遺憾，暗示當時沒核對；address 是「地址」。

subject: english
q: 'I wish I had not sold my bike' implies that the speaker sold the bike.
explain: 希望過去沒有賣掉，暗示實際已賣掉；sold 是 sell「賣」的過去分詞。

subject: english
q: 'I wish the neighbors would lower the music' mainly expresses a desire for ____.
explain: wish ... would 表示盼望行為改變；lower the music 是「把音樂調小聲」。

subject: english
q: If only I ____ French! I cannot understand this visitor.
explain: 目前不會法語，if only 後用過去式表強烈願望；If only 是「要是……就好了」。

subject: english
q: If only we ____ earlier! The tickets were sold out when we arrived yesterday.
explain: 遺憾的是昨天之前沒先訂票，使用過去完成式；book 在此是「預訂」。

subject: english
q: Use the unreal subjunctive: Nora acts as if she ____ the manager, though she is only a visitor.
explain: 題目指定非真實假設語氣，使用 were；manager 是「主管」，visitor 是「訪客」。

subject: english
q: 'He talks as if he knew everything' proves that he knows everything.
explain: as if 是「好像」，描述說話的樣子，不能證明真的無所不知；prove 是「證明」。

subject: english
q: I would rather you ____ me the truth yesterday instead of lying.
explain: would rather + 另一主詞 + 過去完成式，表對過去的偏好或遺憾；had told 是「當時有告訴」，lying 是「說謊」。

subject: english
q: 'Were I free, I would help' can begin with ____ without changing its meaning.
explain: Were I free 等於 If I were free，假設目前有空；free 在此是「有空的」。

subject: english
q: 'Were not I busy, I would join you' uses the standard uncontracted word order for an unreal condition.
explain: 不縮寫時 not 應放主詞後：Were I not busy；busy 是「忙碌的」。

subject: english
q: The opening clause of 'Had we not stopped, we would have arrived sooner' imagines ____.
explain: Had we not stopped 等於 If we had not stopped，假設過去「沒有停下」；倒裝時 not 放在主詞 we 後。

subject: english
q: In 'Should you need help, call me,' the first clause means ____.
explain: Should you need help 是省 if 的條件句，意為「如果你需要幫忙」，不是問句。

subject: english
q: No sooner had we entered the house ____ the phone rang.
explain: no sooner ... than 表示「一……就……」；no sooner 放句首時用 had we entered 倒裝，後接 than。

subject: english
q: 'We seldom eat out' keeps ordinary subject-verb order because seldom does not begin the sentence.
explain: seldom「很少」未放句首，維持 We eat 的一般語序；eat out 是「外食」。

subject: english
q: In 'Only after Sara arrived did we begin,' inversion occurs in ____.
explain: 主句用 did we begin 倒裝，after 子句維持 Sara arrived；main clause 是「主要子句」。

subject: english
q: 'Only Maya knew the answer' needs no inversion because only modifies the subject.
explain: only 修飾主詞 Maya，並非前置副詞語，不需倒裝；the answer 是「答案」。

subject: english
q: Not until the rain stopped ____ the house.
explain: Not until「直到……才」放句首，前面時間子句不變，主句用 did we leave 倒裝。

subject: english
q: 'Not until ten did the store open' means the store ____.
explain: not until ten 是「直到十點才」，因此十點以前沒有營業；open 是「開門營業」。

subject: english
q: Not only ____ the lost wallet, but she also returned all the money.
explain: Not only 放完整子句前須倒裝，did 後用 find 原形；wallet 是「錢包」。

subject: english
q: 'Not only the teacher but also the students agreed' must use inversion after students.
explain: not only ... but also 串接的是主詞，後面維持一般語序；agree 是「同意」。

subject: english
q: Use the subjunctive: The coach insisted that we ____ the injured player.
explain: 題目指定要求用法的假設語氣，否定為 not 加原形；rush 是「催促、使倉促」。

subject: english
q: 'It is essential that every member arrives on time' uses the base-form subjunctive.
explain: 原形假設語氣應用 arrive，不加 s；essential 是「必要的」。

subject: english
q: 'So narrow was the path that we walked in single file' means the path was ____.
choices: wide enough for us to walk side by side
narrow because we walked on it
so narrow that we walked one behind another
as wide as several people standing together
explain: So narrow was the path 回復為 The path was so narrow；in single file 是「成單列」。

subject: english
q: At the end of the hall ____ a small wooden table.
explain: 地點語放句首，可將主要動詞放名詞主詞前；stood 是 stand「立著、放著」的過去式。

subject: english
q: When pointing to a bus, 'Here it comes' keeps it before comes because it is a pronoun.
explain: here 放句首時，代名詞主詞仍在動詞前；Here it comes 是「它來了」。

subject: english
q: A: I enjoyed the play. B: So ____ I.
explain: 附和一般過去式 enjoyed，以 did 代替重複動作；play 在此是「戲劇」。

subject: english
q: In 'Ella is nervous, and so is Dan,' both Ella and Dan are nervous.
explain: so is Dan 表示「丹也是」，承接前句的狀態；nervous 是「緊張的」。

subject: english
q: A: I am not hungry. B: Neither ____ I.
explain: 前句以 am 表狀態，否定附和也用 Neither am I「我也不餓」；hungry 是「餓的」。

subject: english
q: 'Ray has not signed, and neither has Sue' tells us that Sue ____.
explain: neither has Sue 承接前句的否定完成式，表示蘇也還沒簽；sign 是「簽名」。

subject: english
q: In 'It was at the station that I met Ana,' the emphasized detail is ____.
explain: It was ... that ... 中間的 at the station 是強調焦點，交代「在車站」這個地點。

subject: english
q: It was not until noon that ____ the message.
explain: It was not until ... that ... 的 that 子句維持一般語序；receive 是「收到」。

subject: english
q: 'All I did was open the door' means ____.
choices: I did more than open the door.
explain: All I did was ... 強調「我做的只有……」，此處只做了開門這件事；only 是「只有、僅僅」。

subject: english
q: ____ be careful on the icy steps!
explain: Do + 原形動詞 可加強肯定祈使句語氣；Do be careful 是「務必小心」，icy steps 是「結冰的階梯」。

subject: english
q: In 'I do appreciate your help,' do means the speaker is forced to be grateful.
explain: do 在此強調「確實」，不表示被迫；appreciate 是「感激」。

subject: english
q: This printer works as ____ as the old one.
explain: as ... as 中間用原級；修飾 works 用副詞 quietly「安靜地」。

subject: english
q: 'Tina has as many stamps as Jack' means Tina and Jack have equal numbers of stamps.
explain: as many ... as 表示可數物數量相同；stamps 是「郵票」。

subject: english
q: 'The north route is not as safe as the south route' means ____.
explain: 北線不如南線安全，所以南線較安全；route 是「路線」，safe 是「安全的」。

subject: english
q: 'The hill is not as high as the mountain' proves that the hill is low.
explain: 只說山丘比山低，兩者仍可能都很高；high 是「高的」，low 是「低的」。

subject: english
q: The new desk is ____ wider than the old one, but only by two centimeters.
explain: a little 可修飾比較級，表示「稍微」；wider 是「更寬的」。

subject: english
q: As the storm approached, the sea became ____ dangerous.
explain: more and more dangerous 是「越來越危險」；approach 是「接近」。

subject: english
q: 'The less fuel we use, the more money we save' means using less fuel leads to ____.
explain: less 與 more 對應反向變化：用油越少，省錢越多；savings 是「省下的錢」。

subject: english
q: 'The more you earn, the more you spend' means the percentage of income spent must increase.
explain: 兩個金額同增，不代表支出比例提高，例如兩者均加倍；income 是「收入」，percentage 是「百分比」。

subject: english
q: The damage was worse ____ we first thought.
explain: worse 是 bad「壞的」的比較級，接 than 引出比較對象；worse than we thought 是「比我們想的還嚴重」。

subject: english
q: I prefer tea ____ coffee; tea is my first choice.
explain: prefer A to B 是「比起 B 更喜歡 A」；to 是介系詞，這個偏好比較不用 than。first choice 是「首選」。

subject: english
q: My bicycle is heavier than ____; hers is made of a lighter material.
explain: Mia's 省略後面的 bicycle，兩邊比較的都是腳踏車；material 是「材料」。

subject: english
q: Nina has twice as many cards as Max. Max has six, so Nina has ____ cards.
explain: twice as many ... as 是「數量是……的兩倍」；六張的兩倍是十二張。

subject: english
q: Use formal written English: There are ____ passengers on this bus than on the last one.
explain: passengers「乘客」是可數複數，用 fewer「較少的」；less 用於不可數名詞。

subject: english
q: With the new software, the task takes ____ time than before.
explain: time「時間」在此不可數，用 less「較少的」；fewer 不能修飾此處的 time。

subject: english
q: Jade is taller than any ____ student in her class.
explain: any other student 是「其他任何一位學生」，排除 Jade 本人，避免與自己比較。

subject: english
q: No other runner is as fast as Mia. This means Mia is ____.
choices: as fast as one other runner
explain: no other ... as fast 排除其他跑者達到相同速度，故她比其他人都快；runner 是「跑者」。

subject: english
q: 'The ticket costs no more than ten dollars' sets the price at ____.
explain: no more than 是「不超過、至多」，可能低於或等於十美元；at most 是「至多」，不是恰好十美元。

subject: english
q: 'The soup is too hot to eat now' means it ____.
explain: too hot to eat 表示「太燙而無法吃」，須等降溫；yet 在此是「還、尚」。

subject: english
q: The shelf is ____ to hold all these books.
explain: enough 修飾形容詞時放在其後；strong enough 是「足夠堅固的」。

subject: english
q: 'Lily is old enough to vote' does not tell us whether she actually votes.
explain: old enough 表示年齡達到條件，不能推論實際有投票；vote 是「投票」。

subject: english
q: It was ____ lovely day that we ate outside.
explain: 單數可數名詞前用 such a 加形容詞；a lovely day 是「美好的一天」。

subject: english
q: Ella called the office yesterday, and Sam ____ too.
explain: 前句為一般過去式，did 代替 called the office；office 是「辦公室」。

subject: english
q: 'Did Mina submit the form?' 'She said she would, but she did not.' The omitted action is ____.
explain: did not 後省略問題中的 submit the form「繳交表格」，不是省略 said。

subject: english
q: A: Would you like to join our picnic? B: I would love to. B wants to ____.
explain: would love to 後省略重複的 join our picnic，表示「很想參加野餐」。

subject: english
q: A: Will the team win? B: I hope so. B hopes that ____.
explain: I hope so 用 so 代替肯定子句，表示「希望球隊會贏」；win 是「獲勝」。

subject: english
q: After 'Will the flight be canceled?', 'I hope not' means the speaker hopes for a cancellation.
explain: I hope not 是「希望不會」，表示不希望航班被取消；cancellation 是「取消」。

subject: english
q: 'Is your phone charged? If not, use mine.' Here if not means ____.
choices: if you do not own my phone
if my phone is not charged
if your phone is not charged
if your phone is fully charged
explain: if not 等於 if your phone is not charged，指手機沒充好電；charged 是「已充電的」。

subject: english
q: In 'While still young, Helen moved abroad,' the understood subject of while still young is ____.
explain: 省略部分還原為 While Helen was still young，與主句共用 Helen；abroad 是「到國外」。

subject: english
q: You have never met our new coach, ____ you?
explain: never「從未」使主句帶否定意義，附加問句用肯定 have you；coach 是「教練」。

subject: english
q: There is a pharmacy nearby, ____?
explain: There is 的附加問句保留 there，肯定主句搭配否定 isn't there；pharmacy 是「藥局」。

subject: english
q: Let's take a short break, ____?
explain: Let's 表共同提議，附加問句慣用 shall we；take a break 是「休息一下」。

subject: english
q: 'Not necessarily safe' means 'definitely unsafe'.
explain: not necessarily safe 是「不一定安全」，仍可能安全；不能當成 definitely unsafe「一定不安全」。

subject: english
q: The floor is wet. You had better ____ here.
explain: had better 的否定是 had better not 加原形；not run 是「不要跑」。

subject: english
q: The coat has one loose button but is otherwise perfect. 'Otherwise' means ____.
explain: otherwise 在此是「除此之外、在其他方面」，表示除了鈕扣鬆脫，外套其餘部分都很好，並非「否則」。

subject: english
q: We call the path safe, but the guide says otherwise. The guide agrees that it is safe.
explain: says otherwise 是「說法不同」，此處導遊不認同小路安全的判斷；不是承接前句表示同意。

subject: english
q: The bag looks nice. More importantly, it protects my laptop. Which feature matters more?
explain: more importantly 是「更重要的是」，把保護筆電排在外觀之前；重量與價格並未提到。

subject: english
q: In 'The tickets are FREE,' the capitals emphasize that no payment is needed.
explain: FREE 是「免費的」；以大寫突出這個字，是在強調不必付費，並沒有改變字義。

subject: english
q: I enjoy the whole album, ____ the final song.
explain: in particular 是「尤其、特別是」，從整張專輯中指出特別喜歡的最後一首歌；album 是「專輯」。

subject: english
q: A paragraph describes one failed project. This example alone proves that every project fails.
explain: one「一個」案例只能說明該次失敗，不能直接推論 every「每個」計畫都會失敗；這是過度概括。

subject: english
q: The task was not just difficult. ____, it was impossible with our tools.
explain: in fact 是「事實上」，由「不只是困難」進一步加強成「用現有工具根本不可能」，不是舉例或時間推移。

subject: english
q: I thought the shop was shut. In fact, it was open. The second sentence ____.
choices: explains why the shop was shut
explain: in fact「事實上」後說店有開，修正原先以為店關門的想法；correct 在此是「修正」。

subject: english
q: Let Mei choose the music. ____, it is her birthday.
explain: after all 是「畢竟」，提醒今天是美的生日，支持讓她選音樂的決定；until then 是「直到那時」。

subject: english
q: I thought Ben would stay home, but he came after all. The final words confirm my original expectation.
explain: after all 在此是「結果還是」；原先以為 Ben 會待在家，結果他卻來了，因此是推翻而非證實原先預期。

subject: english
q: We lost the match, but ____ nobody was injured.
explain: at least 是「至少」，在輸球的壞結果中指出無人受傷這項安慰；injured 是「受傷的」。

subject: english
q: 'At least ten seats are free' allows the possibility that twelve seats are free.
explain: at least ten 是「至少十個」，十個是下限，不是上限；十二個也符合至少十個。

subject: english
q: Both groups used the same method. Ana learned by watching; ____, Ben learned through observation.
explain: likewise 是「同樣地」；watching 與 observation「觀察」對應相同學習方式，不是相反或取代。

subject: english
q: The guide lists risks, then ways to avoid them. How is it organized?
explain: 先列 risks「風險」，再提出避免方法，屬於 problem followed by solution「先提出問題，再給解法」的組織。

subject: english
q: This file is huge. By comparison, the other is tiny. The link compares ____.
explain: by comparison 是「相較之下」；huge「巨大的」與 tiny「極小的」比較兩個檔案的大小，不是因果或修正。

subject: english
q: In 'Usually, the shop closes at six,' usually allows exceptions.
explain: usually 是「通常」，描述一般情況並容許例外，不等於 always「總是」。

subject: english
q: Rina teaches Leo French; conversely, Leo teaches Rina math. What is reversed?
choices: The truth of the first claim
The order of the school subjects
The time of the first lesson
explain: conversely 是「反過來說」，兩人交換教與學的角色；它沒有否定第一件事，也沒有交代上課時間。

subject: english
q: A paragraph explains how to keep library books dry. Which sentence should be removed?
choices: Keep books away from open windows.
Use a waterproof bag in rain.
explain: 段落主題是讓書保持乾燥；屋頂是藍色與此無關，應刪除。waterproof 是「防水的」，其餘句子都與防潮有關。

subject: english
q: Rain means an indoor game; sun means an outdoor game. ____, we will play.
explain: in either case 是「無論哪種情況」，晴雨只改變場地，兩種情況都會比賽；indoor 是「室內的」。

subject: english
q: If it rains, we meet indoors; otherwise, outside. 'In either case, we meet indoors' preserves the plan.
explain: in either case 是「無論哪種情況」；共同結果只有會面，室內只適用下雨時，不能把兩種地點合成室內。

subject: english
q: The guard checked every bag. Only then did the gate open. The gate opened ____.
explain: only then 是「直到那時才」，表示所有包包檢查完後門才開；guard 是「警衛」。

subject: english
q: The notice says, 'Submit the form by Friday noon.' Submitting it Friday morning meets the deadline.
explain: by Friday noon 是「最遲星期五中午」；星期五上午在截止時間之前，符合提交期限。

subject: english
q: The repair ends Friday. Until then, the lift is closed. When is it certainly closed?
explain: until then 是「直到那時」，指維修結束前電梯持續停用；lift 在此是「電梯」，不是維修後才關閉。

subject: english
q: The cafe is closed until Monday. This tells us exactly when the closure began.
explain: until Monday「到星期一為止」交代關閉狀態延續到何時，沒有提供最初開始關閉的日期。

subject: english
q: We met in Taipei in 2024. Previously, we had met in Tainan. Which meeting came first?
choices: Both were at the same time
The text gives no time order
explain: previously 是「先前」，把敘事帶回更早的會面，因此台南那次在台北那次之前。

subject: english
q: After a long wait, the bus eventually arrived. Which detail is NOT stated?
choices: The wait was described as long
Exactly how long the wait was
The bus arrived after the wait
explain: eventually「終於」交代久候後到達；a long wait「等了很久」不是精確時長，文中未說等了幾分鐘。

subject: english
q: I disliked the song at first. Now I love it. My opinion ____.
explain: at first 是「起初」，與 now「現在」的喜愛形成態度變化，不表示一直不喜歡；opinion 是「看法」。

subject: english
q: After 'I once lost a key,' the reader can conclude that the writer often loses keys.
explain: once 在此是「曾經」，只提到一次經驗，不能推出 often「經常」遺失鑰匙。

subject: english
q: We will use paper tickets ____, then switch to digital tickets next month.
explain: for now 是「暫時、目前先」，配合下個月改用電子票的安排；forever「永遠」與之後換票制矛盾。

subject: english
q: In 'The park will remain open for good,' for good means only for the present.
explain: for good 是「永久地」，不是 for now「目前、暫時」；不能把永久開放解讀為只在現階段開放。

subject: english
q: Training takes time now but saves time in the long run. When are the savings expected?
explain: in the long run 是「長期而言」，培訓目前耗時，但較長時間累積下來可省時，不代表每一刻都省時。

subject: english
q: A cheaper lamp needs frequent repairs. Which comparison best captures costs 'in the long run'?
explain: in the long run 是「長期而言」；應比較多年總支出，納入購買與後續維修，不能只看某一筆價格。

subject: english
q: We discussed the exam. Incidentally, my sister knows the teacher. 'Incidentally' adds ____.
explain: incidentally 是「順帶一提」，補上一句相關的旁支話題，不是必然結論或下一步指示。

subject: english
q: 'Getting back to the budget' signals a return to a topic discussed earlier.
explain: getting back to 是「回到……話題」，表示恢復先前談過的預算議題；budget 是「預算」。

subject: english
q: We need two tools, namely a ruler and scissors. 'Namely' introduces ____.
choices: the full list of required tools
explain: namely 是「也就是、即」，把所需的兩種工具完整指明；不是只舉可有可無的例子。

subject: english
q: Visitors may bring snacks such as fruit and nuts. The wording rules out every other snack.
explain: such as 是「例如」，水果和堅果只是例子，並未排除其他點心；rule out 是「排除」。

subject: english
q: You may mail the form. ____, you can submit it online; both methods remain available.
explain: alternatively 是「或者、也可選擇」，提出另一個仍可使用的途徑，沒有取消郵寄；submit 是「提交」。

subject: english
q: If your appeal succeeds, the fee is canceled. Failing that, you must pay. When must you pay?
explain: failing that 是「若不成功，則……」；前面的申訴若未成功，才須付費。appeal 在此是「申訴」。

subject: english
q: Amy and Ben chose tea and milk, respectively. What did Ben choose?
explain: respectively 是「分別、依序」，人名與飲料按順序配對：Amy 選茶，Ben 選牛奶。

subject: english
q: Amy, Ben, and Cal rank second, third, and first, respectively. Who ranks above Amy?
explain: respectively 是「依序、分別」；Amy 第二、Ben 第三、Cal 第一，因此只有 Cal 名次高於 Amy。

subject: english
q: The reporter says, 'The claim has not been verified.' How should readers treat it?
explain: not been verified 是「尚未查證」，應視為未確認資訊；尚未證實為真，不代表已經證實為假。

subject: english
q: According to the coach, practice starts at six. The writer identifies the coach as the source of this time.
explain: according to the coach 是「根據教練的說法」，標明時間資訊來自教練；source 是「來源」。

subject: english
q: Tara locked the gate. Ben did so too. What did Ben do?
explain: did so too 是「也做了同樣的事」，承接 Tara 的 locked the gate「鎖門」，所以 Ben 也鎖了門。

subject: english
q: Owen may resign, but I hope he will not do so. What does the speaker hope?
choices: Owen will make someone else resign
explain: do so 承接 resign「辭職」；希望他 not do so，只能確定希望他不要辭職，不能保證他的職位一定保住。

subject: english
q: A: Will the trip be canceled? B: I hope not. What does B want?
choices: The trip not to be canceled
explain: I hope not 是「希望不會如此」，否定前述「行程被取消」；只表達希望不取消，沒有指定是否按原時間出發。

subject: english
q: 'A: Will they leave? B: I think so.' B expects them to leave but does not express certainty.
explain: I think so 是「我想會」，so 承接 they will leave「他們會離開」，表達預期而非完全確定。

subject: english
q: Lily chose science; Max, history. What is left unstated after 'Max'?
explain: 平行分句省略前面已出現的 chose「選擇」；完整意思是 Max chose history，而不是教或沒通過歷史。

subject: english
q: 'I missed the last train,' the narrator says. The narrator is also a character in the event.
explain: 敘述者用 I「我」說自己錯過末班車，因此也參與故事事件；narrator 是「敘述者」。

subject: english
q: Mia checked her watch three times while waiting. Which feeling is most strongly suggested?
explain: 等候時反覆看錶，最能暗示 impatience「不耐煩、心急」；relief「鬆口氣」、indifference「漠不關心」與 contentment「滿足」均缺乏線索。

subject: english
q: The doors were locked. 'What a warm welcome!' Jo said sarcastically. Jo felt ____.
explain: sarcastically 是「諷刺地」；門鎖著卻說「真熱情的歡迎」，實際表達感到不受歡迎，而不是感謝。

subject: english
q: In a cycling guide, 'you should wear a helmet' uses 'you' to address ____.
choices: the writer describing their own habits
a named character in a story
a speaker quoted in the guide
explain: 自行車指南中的 you 泛指適用的騎車讀者；helmet 是「安全帽」，不是作者自稱或故事中的特定角色。

subject: english
q: In 'You pressed the wrong button, Ken,' you refers to people in general.
explain: 呼語 Ken 明確指出說話對象，因此 you 指 Ken 這個人，而不是泛指所有人；button 是「按鈕」。

subject: english
q: Maya reads while walking. Such behavior can be risky. 'Such behavior' means ____.
explain: such behavior 是「這類行為」，把前面的邊走路邊閱讀歸為一類；risky 是「有風險的」。

subject: english
q: A robin landed nearby. The bird began to sing. Why use 'the bird'?
choices: It names the same creature more generally
explain: robin 是「知更鳥」，bird「鳥」是涵蓋它的較廣類別；換用上位詞仍指同一隻鳥，可形成詞彙銜接。

subject: english
q: Do not repair the plug yourself; contact an electrician instead. The main advice is to ____.
choices: get help from a trained worker
ask an untrained friend to repair it
explain: 通知禁止自行修插頭，改建議找 electrician「電工」，重點是請受過訓練的人協助，不是繼續使用或自行修理。

subject: english
q: The notice says 'Staff only.' It gives every visitor permission to enter.
explain: Staff only 是「僅限工作人員」，限制進入者身分，並非允許每位訪客入內。

subject: english
q: She finally said it: 'I quit.' What does it refer to?
explain: it 先出現，內容在後面的引語 I quit「我退出」才補出；它指她宣布退出的那句話，而不是她本人或聽者的回答。

subject: english
q: The repair failed, but this was clear: the bridge must close. What does this point to?
choices: The need to close the bridge
explain: this 的具體內容由冒號後補出，指「橋必須關閉」這個判斷，不是前句修繕失敗本身；bridge 是「橋」。

subject: english
q: Five volunteers arrived. The helpers cleaned the beach. 'The helpers' refers to ____.
explain: helpers「幫忙的人」承接前句的 volunteers「志工」，用不同詞語指同一群人，並未另引入清潔隊。

subject: english
q: Which heading best fits a paragraph about seeds, roots, and leaves?
explain: seeds「種子」、roots「根」、leaves「葉」都是植物的部位，因此標題應是 Parts of Plants「植物的部位」。

subject: english
q: I bought a bicycle. The chain was rusty. Why can the writer use 'the chain'?
choices: It repeats a previously stated noun
It starts a completely unrelated topic
It names a part associated with the bicycle
It proves who owned the bicycle before
explain: chain 是「鏈條」，可由自行車常有車鏈的部件關係辨認，因此第一次提到也能用 the，不必先出現 chain。

subject: english
q: We entered a classroom. The teacher greeted us. Which link makes 'the teacher' clear?
choices: The same noun appears in both sentences
The teacher is another name for the room
A classroom suggests a teacher in context
The greeting took place before entry
explain: teacher「教師」可由 classroom「教室」的情境關係引入；兩者不是同一物體，也不是兩句重複相同名詞。

subject: english
q: No puppy has been mentioned. Which sentence best introduces one before 'The puppy followed us home'?
choices: That puppy was ours by then.
A puppy waited by the gate.
explain: a puppy「一隻小狗」以不定冠詞引入新對象，後句再用 the puppy 銜接同一隻；其他選項已預設可辨認的小狗。

subject: english
q: Order: P: Mia opened it. Q: Mia got a sealed parcel. R: A book fell out. Which sequence is clearest?
explain: 先收到 sealed parcel「密封包裹」，再以 it 指包裹並打開，之後書掉出來；順序是 Q、P、R。

subject: english
q: An ad says, 'Join our club today and enjoy free classes!' What is its main purpose?
choices: To explain how a class is taught
To warn readers against the club
explain: 廣告以免費課程吸引讀者加入，目的為 persuade「勸說」；不是記述歷史、說明教法或警告別加入。

subject: english
q: The city added signs to prevent crashes. This purpose alone proves that crashes became less frequent.
explain: to prevent crashes 是「為了預防事故」，只交代設置標誌的目的；仍須成效資料才能知道事故是否變少。

subject: english
q: Nora calls the plan wasteful. The writer disagrees. Whose view does 'wasteful' express?
explain: wasteful 是「浪費的」，這個評價來自 Nora；作者明說 disagrees「不同意」，不能把引述當成作者看法。

subject: english
q: Critics call the road unsafe. The writer replies, 'They ignore its new lights.' What does the writer believe?
choices: The critics missed a safety feature
The new lights prove zero risk
explain: 作者認為 critics「批評者」忽略新路燈這項安全設施；ignore 是「忽略」，並未宣稱風險完全為零。

subject: english
q: Which sentence makes an evaluation rather than a directly checkable observation?
choices: The new hall has four doors.
The new hall opened on Monday.
The new hall is wonderfully elegant.
The new hall stands beside the library.
explain: wonderfully elegant「非常優雅」是主觀評價；門數、啟用日與位置則可直接查核，evaluation 是「評價」。

subject: english
q: In 'The shop was cramped but welcoming,' both descriptions are criticisms.
explain: cramped 是「狹窄擁擠的」，屬批評；welcoming 是「讓人感到受歡迎的」，屬讚美，因此不是兩者都在批評。

subject: english
q: Used rhetorically, 'Who would waste a free meal?' expects which answer?
choices: The reader should name a person
explain: rhetorically 表示「以反問方式」；這句預期幾乎沒有人會浪費免費的一餐，不是真的要求提供某人的姓名。

subject: english
q: Who gains from our silence? Only the polluter. The writer urges readers to ____.
choices: let only the polluter discuss it
explain: 沉默只讓 polluter「汙染者」得利，提問隱含呼籲讀者 speak up「發聲」，不是保密或讓對方壟斷發言。

subject: english
q: Admittedly, the app is fast. Still, I would avoid it because it shares private data. What is the writer's decision?
choices: To use it because it is fast
explain: admittedly 是「誠然」，先承認速度快；still「儘管如此」後才是拒用的立場，理由是應用程式會分享個人資料。

subject: english
q: An admission notice says, 'Applicants must attach a school transcript.' Who is it mainly for?
explain: applicants 是「申請人」，school transcript 是「學校成績單」；通知對象是申請入學者，並非所有到校的人。

subject: english
q: The village is ____, far from any city, so we planned the trip ____.
explain: remote 指偏遠的，符合遠離城市；修飾動詞 planned 要用副詞 carefully（仔細地）。

subject: english
q: A ____ conversation lasting two minutes left a strong ____ on me.
explain: brief 是短暫的，符合兩分鐘的談話；a strong 後需名詞 impression（印象），不能用形容詞 impressive。

subject: english
q: Keep the fish ____ by putting it in the fridge ____ after buying it.
explain: 放進冰箱是為了保持 fresh（新鮮的）；修飾放入的時間用副詞 immediately（立刻）。

subject: english
q: The customer was ____ about the price, so I explained it again as ____ as possible.
explain: 需要再說明表示對價格 confused（困惑的）；修飾 explained 用副詞 politely（有禮貌地）。

subject: english
q: The story matched known facts and sounded ____, but the reporter still wanted independent ____ before printing it.
explain: 已知事實吻合，表示 credible（可信的）；independent 後接名詞 evidence（證據），不用形容詞 evident（明顯的）。

subject: english
q: A referee must remain ____ and assess each player ____ rather than favor the home team.
explain: neutral 是中立的，符合不偏袒主場隊伍；修飾 assess（評估）用副詞 fairly（公平地）。

subject: english
q: With our small budget, this plan is ____ because it needs no ____ equipment.
explain: 無須昂貴設備使計畫 feasible（可行的）；修飾 equipment 用形容詞 expensive（昂貴的）。

subject: english
q: The schedule is ____, allowing a quick ____ if our guests arrive late.
explain: flexible 指可彈性調整的；a quick 後接名詞 adjustment（調整），不能接動詞 adjust。

subject: english
q: We ____ the camera from Jo, who ____ it herself the day before.
explain: 從 Jo 借入要用 borrowed；她購買相機早於借相機，以過去完成式 had bought 表示。

subject: english
q: Workers ____ a new road right now to ____ the traffic problem.
explain: right now 表正在施工，用 are building；修路是為了 ease（緩解）交通問題，不是 cause（造成）。

subject: english
q: Since May, our team ____ for its ____ service, which customers say is always on time.
explain: since May 連到現在，用現在完成式被動 has been praised；準時的服務是 reliable（可靠的）。

subject: english
q: The mechanic ____ the worn brakes yesterday to ____ another accident.
explain: yesterday 指明過去時間，用 replaced；更換磨損煞車是為了 prevent（預防）事故。

subject: english
q: The food ____ to each shelter before the storm, leaving ____ supplies that met every family's needs.
explain: 物資在暴風雨前被分配，用 had been allocated；能滿足各家庭需求表示 sufficient（充足的），不是 inadequate（不足的）。

subject: english
q: The plan ____ by the board yesterday because it would ____ the entire budget.
explain: yesterday 搭配過去式被動 was rejected（被否決）；超出預算用 exceed，restore 是恢復。

subject: english
q: I ____ the accident as it happened; I ____ outside the bakery at that moment.
explain: 親眼看到事故用 witnessed（目擊），不是 anticipated（預期）；當時正站著用過去進行式。

subject: english
q: The results ____ tomorrow; until then, the report must remain ____ and cannot be shared.
explain: 結果將被公布，用未來式被動 will be announced；不得分享表示須 confidential（保密的）。

subject: english
q: While Leo ____ home last night, his careless turn resulted ____ a crash moments later.
explain: last night 的進行中背景用 was driving；轉向後才發生事故，應為 result in（導致），不是 result from（起因於）。

subject: english
q: The complaint ____ by our staff, who took care ____ it before noon.
explain: 客訴是被處理，用 was handled；take care of 是處理，介系詞不能換成 for。

subject: english
q: At yesterday's meeting, no objection ____ raised ____ the proposed entrance fee.
explain: 提出異議是 raise an objection to；objection 為單數且被提出，用過去式被動 was raised。

subject: english
q: By next Friday, each guest ____ compensated ____ the delay in serving breakfast.
explain: compensate someone for 表為某損失或不便補償某人；客人被補償，到未來期限用 will have been compensated。

subject: english
q: The charity is committed ____ getting meals ____ to isolated families.
explain: be committed to 是致力於；get meals delivered 表讓餐點被送達，餐點接受動作，須用過去分詞 delivered。

subject: english
q: We succeeded ____ getting the fallen tree ____ before noon.
explain: succeed in 是成功做到；get the tree removed 表讓倒樹被移走，受詞 tree 接受動作，用 removed。

subject: english
q: The residents objected ____ ____ awake by the late-night drilling.
explain: object to 是反對；居民是被噪音弄得無法入睡，要用被動動名詞 being kept。

subject: english
q: We took advantage ____ the quiet afternoon ____ the speech without interruptions.
explain: take advantage of 是利用；to rehearse（排練）是不定詞，表示利用這段時間的目的。

subject: english
q: ____ the train was crowded, we found seats. ____, we did not have to stand.
explain: 後面是完整子句，用 Although（雖然），不用 Despite；找到座位所以不用站，以 As a result（因此）表結果，Otherwise 表否則。

subject: english
q: We could not use the gym ____ repairs. ____, at that very moment, workers were fixing its roof.
explain: repairs 是名詞，前接 because of；工人同時持續修理，用 Meanwhile（與此同時），不是 Afterwards（之後）。

subject: english
q: This program, ____ works without an internet connection, suits travelers. ____, it costs nothing to download.
explain: 非限定關係子句用 which 指 program；免費下載是另一優點，用 Moreover（此外），非 Otherwise（否則）。

subject: english
q: We lowered the music ____ our guests could talk. ____, conversation became much easier.
explain: so that 加完整子句表目的；後句是降低音量的結果，用 Consequently（因此），不是 Conversely（反過來說）。

subject: english
q: Rita usually buys the cheapest meals and is ____. ____, she spent a fortune on dinner yesterday.
explain: economical 指節省的，與花大錢吃一餐相反；Nevertheless（儘管如此）承接反預期，Accordingly 表因此。

subject: english
q: The two tests were ____ in accuracy, giving equally reliable results. ____, we chose the cheaper test.
explain: equivalent 是相等的，符合兩種測試同樣準確；因此可選較便宜者，用 Therefore（因此），不是 In contrast（相較之下）。

subject: english
q: The two accounts ____ each other: one says noon, the other midnight. ____, we cannot accept both.
explain: 兩種時間不同，表示證詞 contradict（互相矛盾），不是 confirm（證實）；不能都採信是結果，用 Consequently。

subject: english
q: Participation is ____. ____, students must attend rather than choose whether to join.
explain: 必須出席表示 compulsory（強制的）；後句改述前句意義，用 In other words（換句話說）。

subject: english
q: While ____ for her turn, Lea read a novel ____ her brother had lent her.
explain: Lea 主動等待，用 waiting；novel 是先行詞，關係子句缺 lent 的受詞，用 which，不用 what。

subject: english
q: ____ the safety course, Jo could explain ____ the alarm worked.
explain: Jo 主動先完成課程，用 Having completed；解釋警報如何運作用 how，what 不表示方式。

subject: english
q: The tools ____ in this box belong to the artist ____ studio we built.
explain: 工具被存放，用 stored 縮減被動關係子句；whose studio 表藝術家的工作室，關係詞須表所有關係。

subject: english
q: Although ____ a place on the team, Hana chose a job ____ allowed her to work outdoors.
